title: Josephine
description: JOSEPHINE follows the psychological fallout after eight-year-old Josephine (Reeves) witnesses a brutal crime in Golden Gate Park. As she acts out, her parents (Tatum and Chan) struggle with helping their daughter cope, while facing the moral responsibility of demanding justice in a world that’s lost its innocence. Open Fri Nov 20, more showtimes to be announced.

title: Enter the Dragon
description: Bruce Lee kicks all the ass in the ultimate martial arts action masterpiece, Enter the Dragon . A martial artist with a bone to pick, Lee vows to take down a reclusive crime lord by beating him in his own Kung Fu tournament. With remarkable combat choreography by Bruce Lee himself, this is one action-packed classic that never gets old and one of the greatest action movies ever made!

title: MALLRATS
description: When Brodie is dumped by his girlfriend, he retreats to the mall with his best friend T.S., whose girlfriend has also left him. Between brooding and visits to the food court, the unmotivated twosome decides to win their girlfriends back with the help of the ultimate delinquents, Silent Bob and Jay, whose continuing adventures take the word “nuisance” to a whole new level.

title: The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth 35mm
description: Brad Pitt returns to his Academy Award-winning role as Cliff Booth, only this time it’s 1977 and it’s a very different Hollywood. Directed by David Fincher from a screenplay by Quentin Tarantino, the film also stars Elizabeth Debicki, Scott Caan, Carla Gugino, Yahya Abdul-Mateen II and Peter Weller.

title: Category H: MALATESTA’S CARNIVAL OF BLOOD + FINAL DESTINATION 3
description: The smell of doughnuts and candyfloss, vomiting on the waltzers and rides that probably haven’t passed any kind of safety test - don’t we all have fond memories of the fun fair? At Category H Film Club, we’re bringing the terror of the fairground Rio’s screen two with a late night double bill of MAL...

title: Earth Girls Are Easy
description: In this musical comedy, Valerie is dealing with her philandering fiancé, Ted, when she finds that a trio of aliens have crashed their spaceship into her swimming pool. Once the furry beings are shaved at her girlfriend’s salon, the women discover three handsome men underneath. After absorbing the native culture via television, the spacemen are ready to hit the dating scene in 1980s Los Angeles. Staff pick by Rhayne, projectionist

title: The Holy Mountain
description: The follow-up to his Midnight Movie sensation El Topo , writer-director Alejandro Jodorowsky’s THE HOLY MOUNTAIN caused a scandal at the 1973 Cannes Film Festival with its flood of sacrilegious imagery, existential symbolism and outrageous violence. Once again, Jodorowsky plays the allegorically named lead, “The Alchemist,” who assembles a group of people from all walks of life and renames them for the planets in the solar system. Putting his recruits through strange mystical rites and divesting them of their worldly baggage, he leads them on a trip to Lotus Island to ascend the Holy Mountain and displace the immortal gods who secretly rule the universe. This gorgeous new digital restoration, overseen by the filmmaker himself, returns Jodorowsky’s most visually extravagant film to all its trippy splendor.

title: The Devils
description: All screenings on a new 35mm print of the 4K restoration of the film. An enduring, singular masterpiece of cinema starring Academy Award-winner Vanessa Redgrave and Oliver Reed, KEN RUSSELL’S THE DEVILS is a prescient epic of obsession and corruption – and a defining work of art from seminal filmmaker Ken Russell. Assembled from the original camera negative, this new 4K restoration presents Ken Russell’s definitive vision of The Devils by referencing the edit he privately constructed in 2004. The film’s sound has been remastered from original English Composite 35mm Mag Film, transferred at 96kHz, plus other original film elements in selected spots as needed. The Picture and Sound restoration was performed by Warner Bros. Post Production Creative Services, Water Tower Color, and Warner Bros. Sound.

title: The Conversation
description: Coppola’s masterful thriller and Cannes Palme d’Or winner showcases what may be Gene Hackman’s greatest performance. Lonely wiretapping expert and devout Catholic Harry Caul (Hackman) is hired to record a seemingly innocuous conversation between two lovers in San Francisco’s Union Square. Upon re-hearing the tapes, however, Caul believes he may be putting the couple in danger if he turns the material over to his client (Robert Duvall). But what one hears can ultimately turn out to be quite different from what was actually recorded. Restored in 4K in 2024 by American Zoetrope, in collaboration with Studiocanal at Roundabout Entertainment and American Zoetrope laboratories, from the original negative accessed for the first time. An approved 35mm reference print was used for the color grading. 5.1 soundtrack created in 2000 by Walter Murch. Restoration approved by Francis Ford Coppola. Winner: Palme d’Or, Cannes Film Festival 1974

title: Once Upon A Time In… Hollywood
description: Quentin Tarantino’s Once Upon a Time in… Hollywood visits 1969 Los Angeles, where everything is changing, as TV star Rick Dalton (Leonardo DiCaprio) and his longtime stunt double Cliff Booth (Brad Pitt) make their way around an industry they hardly recognize anymore. The ninth film from the writer-director features a large ensemble cast and multiple storylines in a tribute to the final moments of Hollywood’s golden age.

title: Female Trouble
description: “Sex offenses that would shock the Marquis de Sade!” sniffed critic Rex Reed in the Daily News, reviewing John Waters’ follow-up to the notorious Pink Flamingos . The perversities pile up in the tale of high-school delinquent and meatball sandwich-lover Dawn Davenport (played by Waters muse Divine), whose number one Christmas wish is for a pair of cha-cha heels. But her parents fail to heed her request, and her rage leads inexorably to stripping, prostitution, disfigurement, tabloid fame and mass murder.

title: Station West
description: After two U.S. cavalrymen transporting a gold shipment get killed, U.S. Army Intelligence investigator John Haven goes undercover to a mining and logging town to find the killers.

title: Naza
description: In secret conversations on the rooftops of Tel Aviv at night, the systems behind Israel’s calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians in Gaza are revealed by the people who designed and operated them. We made this film out of a sense of obligation to use our position as Israeli filmmakers and journalists to examine the systems behind the mass killing of Palestinian civilians for which our country is responsible. While filming members of Israel’s military on rooftops at night in Tel Aviv over the past three years, we found ourselves asking the very questions that were asked by our grandparents’ generation and throughout the 20th century: how does one group of people allow the total dehumanization of another? What do the inner workings of such a system look like? Many of the revelations in the film were published almost immediately as we learned of them, in the months following the October 7th attacks, by The Guardian (one of NAZA ’s producers), in collaboration with reporting partners +972 Magazine and Local Call. The film lets us explore something deeper than we could in our investigative journalism alone: not only the words being said but also those that are not said, the silence. It is up to all of us to break that silence. — Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor

title: Ben'imana
description: In 2012, eighteen years after the genocide against the Tutsi, a Rwandan village is still learning how to live with itself. Vénéranda has spent years helping survivors and the families of those responsible speak the words that were never said between them. However, forgiveness comes easier when it’s someone else’s story. When her own daughter’s future becomes entangled with the past, Vénéranda is forced to find her own words at last. Spanning three generations of women, BEN’IMANA is an intimate portrait of inherited silence — and the fragile question of whether people who have survived the unspeakable together can still build a life side by side.

title: 14th
description: Please note that there are additional showtimes of 14TH that screen with open captions (on-screen display of dialogue and sounds). For those showtimes, click here. Written in the wreckage of the Civil War, the 14th Amendment was meant to codify the promise of freedom and citizenship. Instead, it has become a permanent argument. Oscar nominee DuVernay’s new documentary pulls this fight out of the footnotes and into the present, chronicling a vicious battle that has raged for more than 150 years. Threading deep archival scholarship with today’s headlines, 14TH brings together legal minds, politicians, historians and cultural voices to explore a question America still hasn’t settled: Who gets to belong?

title: Goodbye, Dragon Inn
description: The Fu-Ho Grand, a movie palace in Taipei, is closing its doors. Its valedictory screening: King Hu’s 1967 wuxia epic Dragon Inn, playing to a motley smattering of spectators, including two stars of Hu’s original opus, Miao Tien and Shih Chun, watching their younger selves with tears in their eyes.

title: Jurassic Park
description: In Steven Spielberg's massive blockbuster, paleontologists Alan Grant (Sam Neill) and Ellie Sattler (Laura Dern) and mathematician Ian Malcolm (Jeff Goldblum) are among a select group chosen to tour an island theme park populated by dinosaurs created from prehistoric DNA. While the park's mastermind, billionaire John Hammond (Richard Attenborough), assures everyone that the facility is safe, they find out otherwise when various ferocious predators break free and go on the hunt.

title: Josephine
description: After eight-year-old Josephine witnesses a violent assault in San Francisco’s Golden Gate Park, the trauma begins to reshape her world, and her fear and confusion slowly unravel the household around her. Channing Tatum and Gemma Chan star as her parents in Beth de Araújo’s acclaimed drama, winner of both the Grand Jury Prize and the Audience Award at the 2026 Sundance Film Festival.

title: Thunderbirds Double Bill - Atlantic Inferno / A
description: This cinematic double-bill brings two of Thunderbirds’ best-loved adventures into an electrifying big screen experience – Atlantic Inferno and Attack of the Alligators.

title: THAT DAY, ON THE BEACH
description: The debut Eighties slow-cinema jam by Taiwanese legend Edward Yang (YI YI, MAHJONG, TAIPEI STORY). Often cited as the opening shot of the Taiwanese New Wave, THAT DAY… intertwines memories and the illusion of reality, reflecting the country’s rapid changes through the life experiences of nuanced female characters. Two estranged friends reunite and end up reminiscing, dreaming and sharing their deepest secrets in this intimate chamber piece. Yang had to seriously convince his studio to allow future camera star Christopher Doyle (CHUNGKING EXPRESS, 2046, LAST LIFE IN THE UNIVERSE) to shoot the film, which would go on to win Best Cinematography at the 1983 Asia-Pacific Film Festival.

title: My Neighbor Totoro
description: Satsuki and Mei's mother has taken ill. In order to be closer to her while she recovers in a rural convalescent hospital, their father moves the two sisters from their home in a city to the countryside. The house they move into is a ramshackle old place in the shadow of an ancient camphor tree, and Satsuki and Mei embark on adventures with the wondrous forest spirits who live nearby.

title: Disney's Hexed
description: An awkward teenage boy and his Type-A mom discover that what makes him unusual might be magical powers that will turn their lives and a secret world of magic upside down.

title: Fatherland
description: The true story of the relationship between the Nobel Prize-winning writer Thomas Mann (Hanns Zischler) and his daughter Erika (Sandra Hüller) - actress, writer and rally driver. In the summer of 1949, at the height of the Cold War, father and daughter embark on a challenging and emotional road trip in a black Buick taking them across a Germany in ruins - from US dominated Frankfurt to Soviet controlled Weimar. Returning home after sixteen years of exile in the US, Thomas Mann has to face not only a divided fatherland, but also a deep fracture within his own family.

title: Ebenezer: A Christmas Carol
description: A thrilling ghost story set in Dickens' London, following one man's supernatural journey to face his past, present and future as he fights for a second chance at redemption.

title: L'AMORE
description: Conceived as an homage to the range and artistry of Anna Magnani, L’AMORE is a diptych that drags the actress to the brink and watches, mouth agape, as she leaps into the abyss. The first part—“The Human Voice”—adapts a one-act play by Jean Cocteau, which Magnani had performed on stage in 1942, playing a woman whose only connection to her lover runs through the telephone wire. Shot in a French studio over two weeks with money that Rossellini had procured for GERMANY YEAR ZERO, this intensely claustrophobic showcase for Magnani (and her dog, Micia) renders a break-up as a world-historic event—as it always is for those so spurned. The second episode—“The Miracle”—was based on an original idea by Fellini, who also co-stars as a silent vagabond whom Magnani’s talkative goatherd believes to be the incarnation of Saint Joseph. Throwing herself upon the saint’s blissful body, Magnani wakes in a daze, pregnant and ever closer to the divine. If the monks can report sightings of the Madonna, why cannot Magnani follow her holy path? Although “The Miracle” aroused no complaints from the Vatican, it faced extraordinary hostility in the US, where the lay Catholics of the Legion of Decency launched a successful campaign for the New York Board of Regents to rescind the film’s exhibition license on the basis of alleged sacrilege. Distributor Joseph Burstyn appealed the decision all the way to the Supreme Court, which ultimately ruled in his favor, belatedly bringing cinema under the protection of the First Amendment, and sowing the seeds of censorship’s demise. A miracle indeed.

title: Focker-in-Law
description: A young man named Henry, son of Greg and Pam Focker, faces family chaos when he decides to marry a strong-willed woman who appears to be his complete mismatch.

title: Fatherland
description: Sandra Hüller illuminates the screen in Pawel Pawlikowski’s stunning and existential gem of family, fascism, and Goethe in post-WWII Germany. Fatherland centres on the relationship between the Nobel Prize-winning writer Thomas Mann (Hanns Zischler) and his daughter Erika (Sandra Hüller) – actress, writer and rally driver. In the summer of 1949, at the height of the Cold War, father and daughter embark on a challenging and emotional road trip in a black Buick taking them across a Germany in ruins – from US dominated Frankfurt to Soviet controlled Weimar. Returning home after sixteen years of exile in the US, Thomas Mann has to face not only a divided fatherland, but also a deep fracture within his own family.

title: Wildwood
description: The Portland-set story follows Prue McKeel, who enters an enchanted wonderland when her baby brother Mac is taken by a murder of crows into the forest’s depths.

title: Fantasia on 35mm
description: Walt Disney’s timeless masterpiece is a breathtaking extravaganza of sight and sound! The feature film that exposed millions of impressionable kiddos to the glory of classical music, this gorgeous and symphonic masterpiece will have you waltzing with mythical centaurs, making magic with Mickey Mouse, pirouetting with hippos, and more! Presented in Fantasound – a precursor to surround sound – Fantasia was the first film ever screened in stereo. Widely considered one of the greatest animated features ever made, and in the top 25 grossing films ever, this breathtaking classic never gets old. See the music come to life, hear the pictures burst into song, and experience the excitement that is Fantasia !

title: Fantastic Mr. Fox
description: The Fantastic Mr. Fox, bored with his current life, plans a heist against the three local farmers. The farmers, tired of sharing their chickens with the sly fox, seek revenge against him and his family.

title: STAR TREK: FIRST CONTACT
description: After an epic battle against the Borg, Captain Picard and the crew of the Enterprise follow the Borg Sphere back into the 21st century to prevent the Borg from contaminating Earth’s timeline and preventing Earth’s first contact. Picard and the crew must work together to battle the Borg Queen before she assimilates all of mankind and changes history forever. Resistance is futile.

title: ALICE IN WONDERLAND
description: Join Alice as she chases the White Rabbit into a topsy-turvy world that gets “curiouser and curiouser” as her fantastical adventures unfold. Meet the Mad Hatter, March Hare, Tweedledee & Tweedledum, the Cheshire Cat, the Queen of Hearts and more unforgettable characters, all set against a backdrop of awe-inspiring splendor.
director: Clyde Geronimi / Wilfred Jackson / Hamilton Luske

title: RAISE THE RED LANTERN
description: Nineteen-year-old Songlian, a promising student whose family has been destroyed by her father’s death, is forced to abandon her studies and marry into wealth, becoming the fourth and newest concubine of the aging, unseen Master Chen. Inside his walled estate, she discovers a household ruled by a merciless ritual: each night, red lanterns are lit outside the chambers of whichever wife the master chooses to visit, granting her privilege and status while the others are cast into cold irrelevance. Songlian is drawn into the orbit of her rivals, each shaped by years of fighting for the same scraps of attention. Determined at first to rise above the games, Songlian is gradually worn down by isolation and humiliation until she strikes back, trading secrets and favors to secure her place in Master Chen’s hierarchy. As petty cruelty turns even more dire, Songlian is forced to confront what these desperate measures will cost her soul. Newly restored, RAISE THE RED LANTERN remains a landmark of Fifth Generation Chinese cinema and 1990s international film. The 4K restoration of RAISE THE RED LANTERN was carried out by the Udine Far East Film Festival on the occasion of its 26th edition. The original image and sound negatives were used under the supervision of Director Zhang Yimou. The vintage positive copy, presented at the 1991 Venice International Film Festival and preserved at the Venice Biennale's Historical Archive of Contemporary Arts, was used for color reference. The restoration was made in 2024 at L'Immagine Ritrovata (Hong Kong – Bologna).

title: Pereda: Together
description: Gabino and his partner Luisa – played by Pereda’s repertory collaborators from the theatre troupe Lagartijas Tiradas al Sol – are unsettled by the intrusion of Paco, Gabino’s cousin, into their cramped Mexico City apartment. First, their dog Junto goes missing; then the tap begins to run only boiling water, and the refrigerator breaks down. Pereda captures both the existential ennui of the young trio—their disaffected drift—and the enervating power dynamics that gradually emerge between them. A tense “What’s for dinner?” sequence hints at the vestige of larger relationship squabbles, while the scalding tap pushes the film toward a literal boiling point. Just as the drama begins to feel hemmed in by domestic friction, Pereda opens it back out onto the pastoral, arriving at a sharp but tender vision of the disorientation of youth, the precarious see-saw of kinship, and the impulse to search for something new together.

title: ONCE UPON A TIME IN HARLEM
description: August 1972: A reunion of Harlem Renaissance luminaries is held at Duke Ellington’s St. Nicholas Ave. townhouse. Though many of these figures haven’t seen each other in 50 years, sharp memories, vigorous debates, and unsettled scores soon flow through this stunner of a cocktail party, which features (among others): artists Romare Bearden, Aaron Douglas, and Richard Bruce Nugent; composer Eubie Blake; poet Arna Bontemps; photographer James Van Der Zee; and activists Richard B. Moore and Louise Patterson. After organizing and shooting this extraordinary gathering, filmmaker William Greaves (SYMBIOPSYCHOTAXIPLASM: TAKE ONE) was unable to complete the film before his death in 2014. One of the cameramen that day was his son David, who expertly reshaped this never-before-seen, newly-restored footage into “a film for the ages…one of the greatest cinematic works of creative nonfiction that I’ve ever seen.” – Richard Brody, The New Yorker

Regular engagement begins January 15th, 2027.

description: Tim Burton’s massively entertaining follow-up to his groundbreaking Batman blockbuster goes bigger and bolder with the Penguin (Danny DeVito), Catwoman (Michelle Pfeiffer), and corrupt businessman Max Shrek (Christopher Walken) out to rid the world of the caped crusader (Michael Keaton). Batman Returns remains one of filmdom’s most ambitious sequels, showcasing incredible production design and visual effects, along with standout performances.

title: The Odyssey
description: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.

title: ROME, OPEN CITY
description: Rome, winter 1943: as screeching-tired Gestapo dragnets blanket the “open city,” Resistance leader Marcello Pagliero escapes from his apartment by running across the rooftops (as did co-screenwriter Sergio Amidei in real life), as pregnant widow Anna Magnani prepares for her wedding, parish priest Aldo Fabrizi uses the “frying pan method” to hide the local boys’ bomb brigade’s hardware, and effete Major Harry Feist riffles through his collection of incriminating ID photos—but betrayal, a broad-daylight machine-gunning, a Partisan ambush, blowtorch torture, and death by firing squad loom… Based on actual people and all-too-recent incidents (Magnani’s electrifying final scene was inspired by her enraged pursuit of her boyfriends’s escape by truck); written in a week in Federico Fellini’s kitchen (the only place with heat); shot on a number of the real locations, and cast mainly with non-pros (Fabrizi and second-choice Magnani were already famous, albeit for comedy), OPEN CITY’s documentary look and still hair-raising violence rocked audiences and critics around the world, making Neo-Realism, Rossellini, and Magnani world-famous, sharing the top prize at Cannes, and running twenty-one consecutive months at a single New York cinema. 4K Restoration courtesy Janus Films. 35mm print courtesy Cinecittà.

title: Fjord
description: An immigrant Romanian family living in Norway is subject to an investigation and faces the scrutiny of the local judicial system.

description: On the verge of turning thirty, Julie is faced with a series of choices that force her to pursue new perspectives on her life in contemporary Oslo. Over the course of four years, she navigates love affairs and existential uncertainty as she starts deciding who she wants to become.

title: Wildwood
description: After her baby brother is abducted by a murder of crows, headstrong teenager Prue McKeel (Peyton Elizabeth Lee) launches a desperate rescue mission into the Impassable Wilderness—an enchanted forest hidden just beyond Portland, Oregon. Joined by her hapless but loyal classmate Curtis Mehlberg (Jacob Tremblay), Prue navigates a world of talking animals, bandits, and powerful figures driven by grief and ambition. As the pair is drawn into a conflict threatening the balance of the forest itself, Prue must discover the strength and belief she never knew she possessed. If she hopes to save her brother and protect Wildwood’s fragile future, she will have to risk everything. From Oscar®-nominated and BAFTA®-winning LAIKA, Wildwood is a sweeping adventure about love, sacrifice, and the magic that reveals itself when we dare to look beyond the familiar.

title: Imamura: Eijanaika
description: The film’s title Eijanaika translates directly to “Why not?”, referring to a collective popular movement marked by singing, dancing, and the chanting of “eijanaika” across Japan in the third year of Keio (1867). Emerging at the cusp of epochal change, these ecstatic uprisings came to signify the waning of the Edo period, the collapse of the Tokugawa shogunate, and the onset of the Meiji Restoration amid the intensified influx of Western influence. In characteristic freewheeling Imamura style, the film adopts an insect’s-eye view of history, privileging the perspectives of peasants, prostitutes, and the dispossessed as they are swept along by the tides of history. A sprawling, carnivalesque epic, Eijanaika unfolds through multiple narrative departures: Genji, a farmer who returns to Japan from the United States after being shipwrecked by an American naval vessel; Ine, his wife, who is sold into sex work following his disappearance; Itoman, a Ryukyuan man who travels to mainland Japan seeking revenge for his family’s murder; Furukawa, a samurai who abandons his family to live in Edo with his lover; and Kinzo, a small-town pimp who exerts power over the village as an arms dealer. Though shaped by Imamura’s characteristically nihilistic worldview – one that unsettles any rosy preconceptions about the promises of modernity and the opening up of Japan to the West – Eijanaika is also a relentless and darkly comic spectacle. Its unruly cast of characters, at once loutish and vital, move with the abandon of those who recognise they have nothing left to lose.

description: A genre-defying queer epic spanning generations, inspired by the legacy of beloved Spanish poet and playwright Federico García Lorca.

title: Arabic Cinema Club: MAYBE TOMORROW + Q&A
description: Maybe Tomorrow follows Wafa with intimacy and emotional clarity as she navigates the weight of absence, refusing to let her father's story be forgotten. At once a deeply personal act of love and a quiet form of resistance, the film is rooted in the everyday reality of carrying on when closure feels ...

title: Primetime
description: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history.

title: Rear Window
description: A wheelchair-bound photographer spies on his neighbors from his apartment window and becomes convinced one of them has committed murder.

title: Railway Sleepers preceded by A Child Already Knows
DIVA
description:
A postman secretly records the opera singer who refuses to be recorded. Another cassette contains evidence that powerful people would kill to suppress. When the two worlds collide, Paris becomes a maze of hired killers, impossible escapes and sudden romance.
Jean-Jacques Beineix makes every surface sing: blue light, wet streets, lofts and métro tunnels turn a thriller into an art-pop daydream. Opera and street culture, immaculate design and scruffy obsession exist in the same enchanted city. A defining burst of cinéma du look, made for anyone who has ever loved an image—or a voice—too much.

title: Focker-in-Law
description: A young man named Henry, son of Greg and Pam Focker, faces family chaos when he decides to marry a strong-willed woman who appears to be his complete mismatch.

title: RAISE THE RED LANTERN
description: Nineteen-year-old Songlian, a promising student whose family has been destroyed by her father’s death, is forced to abandon her studies and marry into wealth, becoming the fourth and newest concubine of the aging, unseen Master Chen. Inside his walled estate, she discovers a household ruled by a merciless ritual: each night, red lanterns are lit outside the chambers of whichever wife the master chooses to visit, granting her privilege and status while the others are cast into cold irrelevance. Songlian is drawn into the orbit of her rivals, each shaped by years of fighting for the same scraps of attention. Determined at first to rise above the games, Songlian is gradually worn down by isolation and humiliation until she strikes back, trading secrets and favors to secure her place in Master Chen’s hierarchy. As petty cruelty turns even more dire, Songlian is forced to confront what these desperate measures will cost her soul. Newly restored, RAISE THE RED LANTERN remains a landmark of Fifth Generation Chinese cinema and 1990s international film. The 4K restoration of RAISE THE RED LANTERN was carried out by the Udine Far East Film Festival on the occasion of its 26th edition. The original image and sound negatives were used under the supervision of Director Zhang Yimou. The vintage positive copy, presented at the 1991 Venice International Film Festival and preserved at the Venice Biennale's Historical Archive of Contemporary Arts, was used for color reference. The restoration was made in 2024 at L'Immagine Ritrovata (Hong Kong – Bologna).

title: The Devils
description: All screenings on a new 35mm print of the 4K restoration of the film. An enduring, singular masterpiece of cinema starring Academy Award-winner Vanessa Redgrave and Oliver Reed, KEN RUSSELL’S THE DEVILS is a prescient epic of obsession and corruption – and a defining work of art from seminal filmmaker Ken Russell. Assembled from the original camera negative, this new 4K restoration presents Ken Russell’s definitive vision of The Devils by referencing the edit he privately constructed in 2004. The film’s sound has been remastered from original English Composite 35mm Mag Film, transferred at 96kHz, plus other original film elements in selected spots as needed. The Picture and Sound restoration was performed by Warner Bros. Post Production Creative Services, Water Tower Color, and Warner Bros. Sound.

title: DEVIL IN A BLUE DRESS
description: Denzel Washington stars as Ezekiel “Easy” Rawlins, a decorated war hero who returns home to the segregation of post-war America. Forced to accept an under-the-table job finding a missing socialite, Easy is caught between the white power elite and the vibrant black community of Central Avenue. And as soon as Easy and his trigger-happy friend Mouse (Don Cheadle) find the mysterious Daphne Monet (Jennifer Beals), trouble follows.

title: SINGIN' IN THE RAIN
description: Gene Kelly, Debbie Reynolds and Donald O’Connor star in one of the greatest musicals ever filmed. Musician Don Lockwood (Kelly) rises to stardom during Hollywood’s silent-movie era–paired with the beautiful, jealous and dumb Lina Lamont (Jean Hagen). When Lockwood becomes attracted to young studio singer Kathy Selden (Reynolds), Lamont has her fired. But with the introduction of talking pictures, audiences laugh when they hear Lockwood speak for the first time–and the studio uses Selden to dub her voice. Set during the advent of “talkies,” this film classic song-and-dance numbers celebrate the beginning of movie musicals.

title: Josephine
description: JOSEPHINE follows the psychological fallout after eight-year-old Josephine (Reeves) witnesses a brutal crime in Golden Gate Park. As she acts out, her parents (Tatum and Chan) struggle with helping their daughter cope, while facing the moral responsibility of demanding justice in a world that’s lost its innocence. Open Fri Nov 20, more showtimes to be announced.

title: Tangles

title: ALL OF A SUDDEN
description: In the latest film by Oscar®-winning director Ryûsuke Hamaguchi (DRIVE MY CAR), Virginie Efira (BENEDETTA) stars as Marie-Lou, the progressive director of a nursing home in the Parisian suburbs. Her life changes when she meets Mari (Tao Okamoto), Japanese playwright. As the two women reckon with the lives they have lived, they find new ways to make sense of the time that remains. Following caregivers as they navigate the tensions between idealism and pragmatism, Hamaguchi crafts a film that rests fully in the present, attentive to the delicate unfolding of thought, feeling, and human connection.

title: Cléo from 5 to 7
description: One of the most delightful films of the French New Wave, iconic filmmaker Agnès Varda eloquently captures Paris in the sixties with this real-time portrait of a singer set adrift in the city. A chronicle of the minutes of one woman’s life as she awaits test results of a biopsy, Cléo from 5 to 7 is a spirited mix of vivid vérité and melodrama, featuring a score by Michel Legrand and cameos by Jean-Luc Godard and Anna Karina.

title: You Can See Everything (15) (AD)
description: 34 days before she’s sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew led by Nathan Fielder to document her every move.

title: The Host
description: When a terrifying creature rises from the Han River and brings chaos to Seoul, single dad Gang-du (Song Kang-ho, Parasite) will stop at nothing to rescue his daughter from the clutches of the horrifying Host. Equal parts creature-feature thrill ride and poignant human story, Oscar-winning visionary Bong Joon Ho’s first global smash remains an incredible action drama and propulsively entertaining modern classic . “A thing of beauty, the perfect mixture of the silly and the grave.” – The New Yorker

title: GERMANY, YEAR ZERO
description: Following the international acclaim and box office success of ROME, OPEN CITY and PAISAN, Rossellini took the first of many obstreperous swerves that would come to define his career. His next film would be another dispatch from war-torn Europe, with scenes playing out amidst the rubble with unvarnished immediacy, with unfamiliar and nonprofessional actors populating the cast—but this time, the protagonists would not be resistance fighters liberating Italy, but the defeated Germans muddling through their wasteland reich. Financed largely by the French government, GERMANY, YEAR ZERO became an experiment in radical empathy and its limits, casting about for signs of new life in a nation of crooks, unrepentant Nazis, and pederasts. The only innocent soul is twelve-year-old protagonist Edmund, who cannot qualify for a work permit, but must somehow earn a living to support his household. Even the child recognizes that he has no role models in this world: his brother is a mopey ex-soldier who refuses to register for a ration card, his father is an invalid who muses he’d be better off dead, his neighbors are coarse and severe, his friends are common swindlers, and his former school teacher still preaches that the strong must snuff out the weak. Unsentimental in the extreme and devoid of any comic relief, GERMANY YEAR ZERO plays like a seance for souls who have yet to recognize themselves as the walking dead.

title: THE DEVILS (4K Restoration)
description: Ken Russell’s incendiary vision of religious hysteria returns in a new not-to-be-missed 4K restoration! In seventeenth-century France, charismatic priest Urbain Grandier becomes the target of witchcraft accusations after a convent’s supposed demonic possession. As Sister Jeanne’s obsession with him ...

title: ISHTAR
description: Two down-on-their-luck lounge singers—Warren Beatty and Dustin Hoffman—find themselves in the middle of a political uprising in a small Middle Eastern country. Though it was one of Hollywood’s most notorious box office failures, writer-director Elaine May’s inventive comedy is richly deserving of reappraisal.

title: YOU CAN SEE EVERYTHING
description: Elizabeth Holmes would like to tell her side of the story. Nathan Fielder has a few questions.  Thirty-four days before she is due to begin her prison sentence for fraud, the Theranos founder invites Fielder and fellow filmmaker Lance Oppenheim into the home she shares with her partner, Billy Evans....

title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
description: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping will revisit the world of Panem twenty-four years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the Fiftieth Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.

title: You Can See Everything
description: Thirty-four days before she’s sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss.

title: EC: JENNINGS / KIRSANOFF
description: Humphrey Jennings LISTEN TO BRITAIN (1941, 19 min, 35mm) Jennings’s film is a masterpiece of sound mixing; it creates an audio landscape of Britain during the war, with images both accompanying and conflicting with the multitude of sounds. Dimitri Kirsanoff MÉNILMONTANT (1924-25, 38 min, 35mm, silent) “[T]o a remarkable degree, MÉNILMONTANT seems an autonomous creation, as sophisticated and demanding as any narrative film of the silent period, without obvious imitators. Although Richard Abel has astutely called attention to aspects the film shares with Abel Gance’s LA ROUE (1923) and Leon Moussinac’s LE BRASIER ARDENT (1923)…and with Jean Epstein’s COEUR FIDELE (1923)…any comparison of the film as a whole with those admirable works would have to underline the intensity, uniqueness, and exceptional rigor of Kirsanoff’s achievement.” –P. Adams Sitney, THE CINEMA OF POETRY Total running time: ca. 60 min. CLICK HERE TO BOOK TICKETS NOW!

title: Fjord
description: Mihai and Lisbet Gheorghiu, a Romanian-Norwegian Pentecostal couple, move with their five children from Romania to Norway after Mihai’s parents die, seeking closeness to Lisbet’s family, who share their faith. Settling in an isolated coastal village, they form a bond with their neighbors, the Halbergs. When their daughter Elia appears at school with bruises, suspicions arise about the family's strict religious upbringing. Fjord explores clashing worldviews, conformity, tolerance, and the boundaries of freedom and intimacy.

title: The Mummy [1999]
description: The Mummy is a rousing, suspenseful and horrifying epic about an expedition of treasure-seeking explorers in the Sahara Desert in 1925. Stumbling upon an ancient tomb, the hunters unwittingly set loose a 3,000-year-old legacy of terror, which is embodied in the vengeful reincarnation of an Egyptian priest who had been sentenced to an eternity as one of the living dead.

title: Josephine
description: After eight-year-old Josephine witnesses a violent assault in San Francisco’s Golden Gate Park, the trauma begins to reshape her world, and her fear and confusion slowly unravel the household around her. Channing Tatum and Gemma Chan star as her parents in Beth de Araújo’s acclaimed drama, winner of both the Grand Jury Prize and the Audience Award at the 2026 Sundance Film Festival.

title: Disney's Hexed
description: An awkward teenage boy and his Type-A mom discover that what makes him unusual might be magical powers that will turn their lives and a secret world of magic upside down.

title: Prima Facie
description: A young, ambitious trial lawyer (Cynthia Erivo) brilliantly navigates the ruthless London court system where she is unmatched in her defense of the accused, including men charged with sexual assault. Just as her career is taking off, a life-altering event forces her to reckon with her belief in the judicial system that was once the core of her identity.

title: The Muppet Christmas Carol
description: 'Tis the season for love, laughter, and one of the most cherished stories of all time! Join Kermit the Frog, Miss Piggy, and all the hilarious Muppets in this merry, magical version of Charles Dickens' classic tale. Academy Award® winner Michael Caine (Best Supporting Actor) gives a performance that's anything but "bah, humbug!" as greedy, penny-pinching Ebenezer Scrooge. One fateful Christmas Eve, Scrooge is visited by the Ghosts of Christmas Past, Present, and Future. Together with kind, humble Bob Cratchit (Kermit the Frog) and his family, the Spirits open Scrooge's eyes -- and his heart -- to the true meaning of Christmas. Filled with original music and dazzling special effects, THE MUPPET CHRISTMAS CAROL will become a holiday tradition your family will treasure all the days of the year. Featuring the film’s famous long-lost song ‘When Love is Gone’! ------ As always you can expect SING ALONG performances of this new version of THE MUPPET CHRISTMAS CAROL this Christmas - and now we don't need to pretend that we weren't going to just play the lost scene regardless! Costumes aren't mandatory, but 'Tis the season, and we love seeing you dressed up in your favourite Christmas Jumpers! If you're wanting to Sing Along with The Muppet Christmas Carol, simply book for the performances marked SING ALONG [it's next to the start time]. All other screenings will be regular performances, and nothing will be written next to the start time.

description: Set in 1973, during the US’s attempt to overthrow the Chilean government, a hitman for the US government with connections to the JFK assassination suddenly realizes that his own people have put a hit on him to cover up the mess.

title: The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth 35mm
description: Brad Pitt returns to his Academy Award-winning role as Cliff Booth, only this time it’s 1977 and it’s a very different Hollywood. Directed by David Fincher from a screenplay by Quentin Tarantino, the film also stars Elizabeth Debicki, Scott Caan, Carla Gugino, Yahya Abdul-Mateen II and Peter Weller.

title: THE MARRIAGE CIRCLE
description: Doctor Monte Blue is happily married to Florence Vidor, Professor Adolphe Menjou is unhappily married to Marie Prevost—who decides to chase Blue—while Blue’s partner is hoping for an affair with Vidor—and then things really get complicated.

title: PORTRAITS OF THE ARTIST
description: Beginning with Gerard Malanga’s ANDY WARHOL (1964), in which the author of the SCREEN TESTS sits for his own extended portrait, this program finds the directors turning the camera on their fellow filmmakers, or even trading places for complementary films (as in the case of the Friedl vom Gröller and Christiana Perschon films that close the screening). Gerard Malanga ANDY WARHOL: PORTRAITS OF THE ARTIST AS A YOUNG MAN (1964, 21 min, 16mm-to-DCP) Ludwig Schönherr PORTRÄTFILM: KURT KREN (1969, 3.5 min, 16mm-to-DCP, silent) Ludwig Schönherr PORTRÄTFILM: ELISABETH ERKNER (1969, 14 min, 16mm-to-DCP, silent) Barry Gerson PORTRAIT OF ANDREW NOREN (1972, 4 min, 16mm, silent) Friedl vom Gröller I DON’T WANT TO BE FILMED BUT RATHER SHOOT MYSELF / ICH WILL NICHT GEFILMT WERDEN, SONDERN SELBER FILMEN (2023, 3 min, 16mm, silent) Christiana Perschon FRIEDL (2023, 2.5 min, 16mm-to-DCP) Friedl vom Gröller FLO UND KEN JACOBS (2001, 3 min, 16mm, silent) Friedl vom Gröller PETER KUBELKA UND JONAS MEKAS (1994, 2.5 min, 16mm, silent) Jeff Weber PETER (2026, 5.5 min, 35mm, silent) Total running time: ca. 60 min.

title: Minotaur
description: Russia, 2022. Corporate executive Gleb finds himself under siege on all fronts: haunted by suspicions that his wife is unfaithful and facing a demand to draft a quota of employees for war. Though desperate to keep his hands clean, his struggle to reassert control accelerates toward violence.

title: Sonic Cinema: Daïchi Saïto
description: Sonic Cinema and the Japan Foundation present the films of Montreal-based artist Daïchi Saïto, projected from his personal 35mm prints. A rare encounter with a singular voice in artisanal film practice, this programme highlights Saïto’s skill in bridging metaphysical concepts with sensory experience. Originally from Japan, Daïchi Saïto makes films of intense beauty and power, grounded in abstract approaches to landscape, rhythm, and perception. Produced through expressive use of optical manipulation and painstaking frame-by-frame photochemical treatments, the films in this programme carry a tactile and elemental intensity, teasing out the sensual poetry of the natural world and human subjectivity. Drawing on Saïto's studies in philosophy, literature, and the languages of Hindi and Sanskrit, as much as the language of cinema, these are films built on a poetic dialogue of sound and image. Guided by the expressive improvised soundtracks of Malcolm Goldstein and Jason Sharp, we'll traverse exterior and interior landscapes, from the darkened primordial deserts of Saïto's most recent film earthearthearth (2021), through the stained glass forest of Trees of Syntax , Leaves of Axis (2009), before the torrent of memories and cool mountain vistas carries us away in Engram of Returning (2015). Daïchi will join us in person for a Q&A with series curator Oliver Dickens following the screening. Programme earthearthearth , Canada 2021, 30 min., 35mm Trees of Syntax, Leaves of Axis , Canada 2009, 10 min., 35mm Engram of Returning , Canada, Japan 2015, 18’30 min., 35mm Programmed by Oliver Dickens for Sonic Cinema, presented in partnership with the Japan Foundation.

title: SCREAMPLAY + DIRECTOR/STAR RUFUS BUTLER SEDER Q&A
description:
Aspiring screenwriter Edgar Allan arrives in Hollywood and lands a janitor’s job in a fleabag apartment building. His neighbours become characters in his script. Then the murders he writes start happening for real.
Rufus Butler Seder turns a tiny budget into an entire expressionist world: painted sets, silent-cinema tricks and stark monochrome give this Hollywood nightmare a handmade magic. Underground legend George Kuchar is unforgettable as the landlord. A funny, macabre love letter to movie obsession, where the dream factory looks like something assembled in a very gifted man’s bedroom.
Director and star Rufus Butler Seder joins us for a Q&A.

Fatherland
description: Sandra Hüller illuminates the screen in Pawel Pawlikowski’s stunning and existential gem of family, fascism, and Goethe in post-WWII Germany. Fatherland centres on the relationship between the Nobel Prize-winning writer Thomas Mann (Hanns Zischler) and his daughter Erika (Sandra Hüller) – actress, writer and rally driver. In the summer of 1949, at the height of the Cold War, father and daughter embark on a challenging and emotional road trip in a black Buick taking them across a Germany in ruins – from US dominated Frankfurt to Soviet controlled Weimar. Returning home after sixteen years of exile in the US, Thomas Mann has to face not only a divided fatherland, but also a deep fracture within his own family.

title: Twister
description: Let’s go storm-chasing, Vidiots! Helen Hunt and Bill Paxton are a bitterly divorced couple and a pair of determined climatologists out for the adventure of a lifetime in storm country as a record-breaking number of tornados threatens the lives and livelihoods of the Oklahomans in their wake. This unprecedented storm season is the perfect time to risk their lives and attempt to release “Dorothy,” a groundbreaking instrument for storm tracking, and maybe even the perfect setting to rekindle their relationship. More fun than an airborne cow, with the perfect delirious blend of thrills and schmaltz, this is one high-flying adventure that really gets off the ground — and stays there!

title: A CLOCKWORK ORANGE
description: Being the adventures of a young man…who loved a bit of the old ultra-violence…went to jail, was brain washed…and came out cured…or was he? In a futuristic welfare state, Alex (Malcolm McDowell), a vicious young hoodlum, sleeps all day and spends his nights roaming the city with his droogs, assaulting innocent people in the streets and in their homes. Finally captured by the police, Alex undergoes rehabilitation in the form of aversion therapy as brutal and horrifying as any of his offenses.

title: 14th
description: Please note that there are additional showtimes of 14TH that screen with open captions (on-screen display of dialogue and sounds). For those showtimes, click here. Written in the wreckage of the Civil War, the 14th Amendment was meant to codify the promise of freedom and citizenship. Instead, it has become a permanent argument. Oscar nominee DuVernay’s new documentary pulls this fight out of the footnotes and into the present, chronicling a vicious battle that has raged for more than 150 years. Threading deep archival scholarship with today’s headlines, 14TH brings together legal minds, politicians, historians and cultural voices to explore a question America still hasn’t settled: Who gets to belong?

title: EC: THE GENERAL
description: With Buster Keaton, Marion Mack, Glen Cavendar, Jim Farley, and Joseph Keaton.“ In the funniest of all silent feature comedy classics, the imperturbable Buster Keaton is cast as a daring Federal Spy with an outlandish plan to change the course of the Civil War. This sophisticated and grotesque screen farce – eloquently touching, uproariously hilarious – is a perfect example of Keaton’s art. Engulfed by switches, stolen engines, valves, and other mechanical contrivances, the immortal comedian – an engine driver literally on the wrong side of the tracks – solemnly attempts to behave normally in a world which is plainly bewitched.” –CINEMA 16 program notes, 1958 Preceded by: Buster Keaton & Edward F. Spain, 1932. A young man awaits to see if he has secured membership of th...

title: STOP MAKING SENSE
description: The greatest concert film of all time, STOP MAKING SENSE brings to the screen Talking Heads at Hollywood’s Pantages Theater in December 1983: David Byrne, Tina Weymouth, Chris Frantz and Jerry Harrison, alongside an ecstatic ensemble of supporting musicians.

title: EVIL DEAD Trilogy
description: When five college students, led by Ash Williams (Bruce Campbell), arrive at a secluded mountain cabin for vacation, they find themselves under attack by an army of evil spirits and possessed trees. The ancient demon resurrected from a tape recorder the kids find in the cellar isn’t helping, either. Realizing the woods won’t let them leave without a fight, Ash is forced to take matters into his own capable hands and fend off the Deadites picking his friends off one by one.

title: Naza
description: In secret conversations on the rooftops of Tel Aviv at night, the systems behind Israel’s calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians in Gaza are revealed by the people who designed and operated them. We made this film out of a sense of obligation to use our position as Israeli filmmakers and journalists to examine the systems behind the mass killing of Palestinian civilians for which our country is responsible. While filming members of Israel’s military on rooftops at night in Tel Aviv over the past three years, we found ourselves asking the very questions that were asked by our grandparents’ generation and throughout the 20th century: how does one group of people allow the total dehumanization of another? What do the inner workings of such a system look like? Many of the revelations in the film were published almost immediately as we learned of them, in the months following the October 7th attacks, by The Guardian (one of NAZA ’s producers), in collaboration with reporting partners +972 Magazine and Local Call. The film lets us explore something deeper than we could in our investigative journalism alone: not only the words being said but also those that are not said, the silence. It is up to all of us to break that silence. — Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor

title: STROMBOLI
description: Upon seeing PAISAN in 1948, Ingrid Bergman sent Roberto Rossellini a fan letter, offering her services on any project he might want to make. “Well, who is this Ingrid Bergman?” asked Rossellini, unfamiliar with her work. Duly schooled and armed with a promissory note from Hollywood’s most popular actress, Rossellini went calling in California. After failing to come to terms with Samuel Goldwyn and David O. Selznick, Rossellini and Bergman signed a contract with Howard Hughes, the new owner of RKO Radio Pictures, who luckily had no need of reading a script beforehand. Bergman and Rossellini sailed for Stromboli, a remote island that would be the setting for their first picture together. Bergman plays Karin, a Lithuanian refugee whose only hope of getting out of a displaced persons camp after the war is to marry Antonio (Mario Vitale), a simple fisherman. Returning to his modest home on Stromboli, the couple faces one crisis after another: he is too poor to give her the life to which she’s accustomed, she is ostracized by the villagers for a lack of modesty. Nature asserts its supremacy, as volcanoes are wont to do. (Even Antonio’s “gift” of a pet ferret is a cruel reminder of the local food chain.) STROMBOLI becomes a vision quest, a groping towards cosmic grace that reveals a new vulnerability in Bergman that Hollywood never dared tap. Back on terra firma, Rossellini’s rangy artistry was quickly overshadowed by the revelation that he had begun an affair with Bergman and impregnated her. “Probably no film in history has received as much publicity as STROMBOLI,” noted Variety, but leering curiosity did not translate into ticket sales for this intuitively-constructed art film.

title: FILM NO. 5 (SMILE)
description: “[S]hot with a high-speed camera…FILM NO. 5 (SMILE) reveals John Lennon’s face, recorded at 333 frames per second for an extended duration, outdoors, in color, and accompanied by a sound track of outdoor sounds recorded at the same time the imagery was recorded. FILM NO. 5 (SMILE) divides roughly into two halves, one continuous shot each. During the first half, the film is a meditation on Lennon’s face, which is so still that on first viewing I wasn’t entirely sure for a while that the film was live action and not an optically printed photograph of Lennon smiling slightly. Though almost nothing happens in any conventional sense, however, the intersection of the high speed filming and our extended gaze creates continuous, subtle transformations. […] While the second shot is more active than the first, the amount of activity remains minimal by conventional standards (and unusually so even for avant-garde film). It is as though those of us in the theater and Lennon are meditating on each other from opposite sides of the cinematic apparatus, joined together by Ono in a lovely, hypnotic stasis.” –Scott MacDonald, “Yoko Ono: Ideas on Film” Preceded by: Yoko Ono FLUXFILM NO. 16: aka NO. 4: BOTTOMS 1966, 6 min, 16mm-to-digital, silent. Camera: Jeff Perkins, Anthony Cox. Starring: Susannah Campbell, Philip Corner, Anthony Cox, Bici Hendricks, Geoffrey Hendricks, Kyoko Ono, Yoko Ono, Ben Patterson, Jeff Perkins, Susan Poland, Jerry Sablo, Carolee Schneemann, James Tenney, Pieter Vanderbeck, Verne Williams. “The rebellious, erotic, liberatory nature of the film, which reflects the tenor of Fluxus, acts in direct opposition to the nineteenth-century scientific treatment of the body as a ‘dynamic field of action in need of regulation and control.’” –Chrissie Iles, “Erotic Conceptualism: The Films of Yoko Ono” Total running time: ca. 60 min.

title: FiFF: Resistance, Connection, Enclosure: John Maybury in the 1980s
You Can See Everything
description: Thirty-four days before she’s sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss. From boundary-pushing directors Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim comes You Can See Everything.

title: You Can See Everything (15) (AD)
description: 34 days before she’s sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew led by Nathan Fielder to document her every move.

title: RAISE THE RED LANTERN
description: Nineteen-year-old Songlian, a promising student whose family has been destroyed by her father’s death, is forced to abandon her studies and marry into wealth, becoming the fourth and newest concubine of the aging, unseen Master Chen. Inside his walled estate, she discovers a household ruled by a merciless ritual: each night, red lanterns are lit outside the chambers of whichever wife the master chooses to visit, granting her privilege and status while the others are cast into cold irrelevance. Songlian is drawn into the orbit of her rivals, each shaped by years of fighting for the same scraps of attention. Determined at first to rise above the games, Songlian is gradually worn down by isolation and humiliation until she strikes back, trading secrets and favors to secure her place in Master Chen’s hierarchy. As petty cruelty turns even more dire, Songlian is forced to confront what these desperate measures will cost her soul. Newly restored, RAISE THE RED LANTERN remains a landmark of Fifth Generation Chinese cinema and 1990s international film. The 4K restoration of RAISE THE RED LANTERN was carried out by the Udine Far East Film Festival on the occasion of its 26th edition. The original image and sound negatives were used under the supervision of Director Zhang Yimou. The vintage positive copy, presented at the 1991 Venice International Film Festival and preserved at the Venice Biennale's Historical Archive of Contemporary Arts, was used for color reference. The restoration was made in 2024 at L'Immagine Ritrovata (Hong Kong – Bologna).

title: FATHERLAND
description: From the director of IDA and COLD WAR: FATHERLAND follows Nobel Prize-winning author Thomas Mann (Hanns Zischler, KINGS OF THE ROAD) and his actress daughter Erika (Sandra Hüller, ANATOMY OF A FALL) as they drive across a war-ravaged 1949 Germany. Returning home after years of exile in the U.S. and exuding a superhuman gravitas, Mann finds the Germany he knew to be gone, replaced by a country with contradictory ideologies. Erika, who acts as his travel coordinator and translator, strives to pierce his detached persona while quietly struggling with a family tragedy.

title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
description: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping will revisit the world of Panem twenty-four years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the Fiftieth Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.

title: YOU CAN SEE EVERYTHING
description: Elizabeth Holmes would like to tell her side of the story. Nathan Fielder has a few questions.  Thirty-four days before she is due to begin her prison sentence for fraud, the Theranos founder invites Fielder and fellow filmmaker Lance Oppenheim into the home she shares with her partner, Billy Evans....

title: Minotaur (15) (AD)
description: After a nine-year absence having fled his native Russia and gone into exile, Andrey Zvyagintsev makes his long-awaited return; a modern reimagining of Claude Chabrol’s La femme infidèle .

title: Unzipped
description: Designer Isaac Mizrahi proved a force of nature on the road to his legendary fall 1994 collection, a career-defining triumph that was documented with an effervescent intimacy by Douglas Keeve, Mizrahi’s then-partner. Both a time capsule of the buoyant, raucous 1990s, when pop culture and high art became interchangeable, and a vérité-style, in-the-trenches report on the daily agonies and ecstasies of the creative process, this seminal artistic portrait—sumptuously shot by Ellen Kuras and Robert Leacock—transcends glitz and glamour to offer an extraordinary view of the charisma and force of will inherent to genius, as well as its personal costs. Digitally restored by the Sundance Institute and UCLA Film & Television Archive. Funding provided by Isaac Mizrahi Entertainment. Laboratory services by Roundabout Entertainment, Inc. and Deluxe Media Audio Services.

title: You Can See Everything

title: MYSTERY MOVIE
description:
Take a seat without knowing what is coming. Our mystery screenings explore the bold, disreputable and gloriously unclassifiable world of psychotronic cinema: discoveries that make you wonder how they were made, who they were made for, and why nobody showed you sooner.
The title stays secret until showtime. Curiosity is essential; good taste is negotiable.
Strictly for adult audiences. Films may contain offensive and upsetting content. Do not attend if you are of a sensitive disposition.

title: Disney's Hexed
description: An awkward teenage boy and his Type-A mom discover that what makes him unusual might be magical powers that will turn their lives and a secret world of magic upside down.

title: Off-Circuit: My Wife Cries
description: A phone call brings Thomas to a hospital, where he finds his wife Carla in tears. As the circumstances of her accident come into focus, so too does a relationship whose familiar terms suddenly seem uncertain. From this deceptively simple premise, Angela Schanelec constructs a relationship drama that resists the conventions of the genre in favour of something decidedly more elliptical. As conversations circle what remains unspoken; gestures and silences come increasingly to the fore with a spellbinding intensity. My Wife Cries is at once formally audacious and acutely attentive to the emotional lives of its characters and how quickly intimacy can give way to estrangement. The screening on Friday 20 November will be followed by an in-person Q&A with Angela Schanelec.

title: Focker-in-Law
description: A young man named Henry, son of Greg and Pam Focker, faces family chaos when he decides to marry a strong-willed woman who appears to be his complete mismatch.

title: Stop Making Sense
description: Stop Making Sense stars core band members David Byrne, Tina Weymouth, Chris Frantz, and Jerry Harrison along with Bernie Worrell, Alex Weir, Steve Scales, Lynn Mabry and Edna Holt. The live performance was shot over the course of three nights at Hollywood's Pantages Theater in December of 1983 and features Talking Heads' most memorable songs.

title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
description: From writer-director Bassam Tariq, Your Mother, Your Mother, Your Mother stars Mahershala Ali as Latif, a devoutly religious hitman who struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the forces closing in around him - and the beliefs threatening to unravel within.

title: Ken Russell's The Devils: The Director's Cut
description: Censored for more than half a century, Ken Russell’s visionary masterpiece returns to the big screen fully restored in 4K and cut to Russell’s direction - the first publicly released version of the film as intended by the filmmaker. Unveiled at the 79th Cannes Film Festival, the definitive version arrives 55 years after the film’s original release. An enduring masterpiece of cinema starring Oliver Reed and Vanessa Redgrave, Ken Russell’s The Devils is a prescient epic of obsession and corruption, and a defining work of art from seminal filmmaker Ken Russell. Inspired by the true story of 17th-century priest Urbain Grandier, accused of bewitching a convent of nuns, the film lays bare the collusion of church and state through a searing vision of religious persecution, collective hysteria and institutional corruption. In addition to powerhouse performances from Reed and Redgrave, Ken Russell’s The Devils showcases the stunning work of artists at the peak of their craft: Academy Award-winning cinematographer David Watkin (Out of Africa, Chariots of Fire); editor Michael Bradsell (Local Hero, Jabberwocky); and visual artist Derek Jarman (Jubilee, Caravaggio), whose work as production designer marked his feature film debut.

title: The Devils
description: All screenings on a new 35mm print of the 4K restoration of the film. An enduring, singular masterpiece of cinema starring Academy Award-winner Vanessa Redgrave and Oliver Reed, KEN RUSSELL’S THE DEVILS is a prescient epic of obsession and corruption – and a defining work of art from seminal filmmaker Ken Russell. Assembled from the original camera negative, this new 4K restoration presents Ken Russell’s definitive vision of The Devils by referencing the edit he privately constructed in 2004. The film’s sound has been remastered from original English Composite 35mm Mag Film, transferred at 96kHz, plus other original film elements in selected spots as needed. The Picture and Sound restoration was performed by Warner Bros. Post Production Creative Services, Water Tower Color, and Warner Bros. Sound.

title: Tangles
description: Mon, Nov 23: Sneak preview + extended intro by Julia Louis-Dreyfus at 8:40! Mon, Nov 23: Sneak preview + extended intro by Julia Louis-Dreyfus at 9:05! Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Sarah Silverman, Abbi Jacobson, Seth Rogen and Bryan Cranston voice a family struggling with their mother’s Alzheimer’s diagnosis in this deeply moving, animated adaptation of Sarah Leavitt’s acclaimed graphic novel. Regular engagement begins January 15th, 2027.

title: The Host
description: When a terrifying creature rises from the Han River and brings chaos to Seoul, single dad Gang-du (Song Kang-ho, Parasite) will stop at nothing to rescue his daughter from the clutches of the horrifying Host. Equal parts creature-feature thrill ride and poignant human story, Oscar-winning visionary Bong Joon Ho’s first global smash remains an incredible action drama and propulsively entertaining modern classic . “A thing of beauty, the perfect mixture of the silly and the grave.” – The New Yorker

title: The History of Concrete
description: Fri, Sep 18: Q&A with dir. John Wilson, moderated by Edy Modica (actress, comedian, filmmaker), after 4:40 show! Fri, Sep 18: Q&A with dir. John Wilson, moderated by Rachel Kaly (comedian, writer, actor), after 7:15 show! Sun, Sep 20: Q&A with dir. John Wilson, moderated by Sarah Sherman after 2:10 show! Following the finale of his TV show, filmmaker John Wilson searches for a new creative outlet. After attending a workshop on how to write and sell a Hallmark movie, he attempts to apply the same formula to a documentary about concrete.

title: Josephine
description: JOSEPHINE follows the psychological fallout after eight-year-old Josephine (Reeves) witnesses a brutal crime in Golden Gate Park. As she acts out, her parents (Tatum and Chan) struggle with helping their daughter cope, while facing the moral responsibility of demanding justice in a world that’s lost its innocence. Open Fri Nov 20, more showtimes to be announced.

title: Oldboy
description: One of the greatest – and most twisted – revenge thrillers of all time, this visceral thrill ride from Park Chan-wook never gets old. Come see the original “hallway fight” and so much more when Park Chan-wook’s Oldboy returns, restored and remastered in stunning 4K. For over twenty years, this cult classic has been thrilling audiences and inspiring other filmmakers. Grab a friend (or an octopus) and come experience Oldboy on the big screen.

title: Wild Horse Nine
description: Set in 1973, during the US’s attempt to overthrow the Chilean government, a hitman for the US government with connections to the JFK assassination suddenly realizes that his own people have put a hit on him to cover up the mess.

title: BRAM STOKER'S DRACULA
description: Gary Oldman, Winona Ryder and Anthony Hopkins star in director Francis Ford Coppola’s visually stunning, passionately seductive version of the classic Dracula legend. In BRAM STOKER’S DRACULA, Coppola returns to the original source of the Dracula myth, and from that gothic romance, he creates a modern masterpiece. Gary Oldman’s metamorphosis as Dracula who grows from old to young, from man to beast is nothing short of amazing. Winona Ryder brings equal intensity to the role of a young beauty who becomes the object of Dracula’s devastating desire. Anthony Hopkins co-stars as the famed doctor who dares to believe in Dracula, and then dares to confront him.

title: The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth 35mm
description: Brad Pitt returns to his Academy Award-winning role as Cliff Booth, only this time it’s 1977 and it’s a very different Hollywood. Directed by David Fincher from a screenplay by Quentin Tarantino, the film also stars Elizabeth Debicki, Scott Caan, Carla Gugino, Yahya Abdul-Mateen II and Peter Weller.

title: Studio Ghibli All-Nighter
description: ALL NIGHTER : FAQs, HOUSE RULES & TIPS Celebrate the legacy of 'the greatest animation house on the planet' with some of the most adored and iconic characters of all-time in this All-Night Movie Marathon! MY NEIGHBOR TOTORO: When two girls move to the country to be near their ailing mother, they have adventures with the wondrous forest spirits who live nearby. KIKI’S DELIVERY SERVICE: Along with her black cat Jiji, Kiki settles in a seaside town and starts a high-flying delivery service. Here begins her magical encounter with independence and responsibility, making lifelong friends and finding her place in the world. HOWL’S MOVING CASTLE: When an unconfident young woman is cursed with an old body by a spiteful witch, her only chance of breaking the spell lies with a self-indulgent yet insecure young wizard and his companions in his legged, walking castle. PRINCESS MONONOKE: After a deadly curse forces him from home, young warrior Ashitaka journeys west and is drawn into a conflict between ancient forest spirits, an iron town, and a wolf-raised girl. SPIRITED AWAY: During her family's move to the suburbs, a sullen 10-year-old girl wanders into a world ruled by gods, witches and spirits, and where humans are changed into beasts. ------------------------------------------------------------------------- NO ADMISSIONS TO THE CINEMA AFTER MIDNIGHT NO ALCOHOL PURCHASED FROM OUTSIDE IS PERMITTED IN THE BUILDING! AGE RESTRICTIONS: This is strictly a 16+ event. Due to the event running through the night, anyone under the age 18 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian [aged 18+] for the full duration of the marathon.

title: Something Wicked This Way Comes: a folk + cosmic horror rave
description: After experiencing our horrors through the silver screen they’ve graciously offered to visit in person for a heretical multimedia rave experience. The bog witches and poltergeists, old gods and jinn, eldritch and uncanny alike, will descend upon the Rio Cinema for a manifestation of love only their ...

title: Earth Girls Are Easy
description: In this musical comedy, Valerie is dealing with her philandering fiancé, Ted, when she finds that a trio of aliens have crashed their spaceship into her swimming pool. Once the furry beings are shaved at her girlfriend’s salon, the women discover three handsome men underneath. After absorbing the native culture via television, the spacemen are ready to hit the dating scene in 1980s Los Angeles. Staff pick by Rhayne, projectionist

title: The Holy Mountain
description: The follow-up to his Midnight Movie sensation El Topo , writer-director Alejandro Jodorowsky’s THE HOLY MOUNTAIN caused a scandal at the 1973 Cannes Film Festival with its flood of sacrilegious imagery, existential symbolism and outrageous violence. Once again, Jodorowsky plays the allegorically named lead, “The Alchemist,” who assembles a group of people from all walks of life and renames them for the planets in the solar system. Putting his recruits through strange mystical rites and divesting them of their worldly baggage, he leads them on a trip to Lotus Island to ascend the Holy Mountain and displace the immortal gods who secretly rule the universe. This gorgeous new digital restoration, overseen by the filmmaker himself, returns Jodorowsky’s most visually extravagant film to all its trippy splendor.

title: The Films of Matt Johnson Marathon
description: ALL NIGHTER : FAQs, HOUSE RULES & TIPS One of modern cinema's great cult heroes gets the all-night PCC treatment as we celebrate the films of Matt Johnson with back-to-back screenings of THE DIRTIES, OPERATION AVALANCHE, BLACKBERRY, NIRVANNA THE BAND THE SHOW THE MOVIE, and TONY. THE DIRTIES: The line between reality and fiction starts to blur when two best friends start making a movie about getting revenge on bullies. OPERATION AVALANCHE: In 1967, four undercover CIA agents were sent to NASA posing as a documentary film crew. What they discovered led to one of the biggest conspiracies in American history. BLACKBERRY: Two mismatched entrepreneurs – egghead innovator Mike Lazaridis and cut-throat businessman Jim Balsillie – joined forces in an endeavour that was to become a worldwide hit in little more than a decade. The story of the meteoric rise and catastrophic demise of the world's first smartphone. NIRVANNA THE BAND THE SHOW THE MOVIE: When their plan to book a show at the Rivoli goes horribly wrong, Matt and Jay accidentally travel back to the year 2008. TONY: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life. ------------------------------------------------------------------------- NO ADMISSIONS TO THE CINEMA AFTER MIDNIGHT NO ALCOHOL PURCHASED FROM OUTSIDE IS PERMITTED IN THE BUILDING! AGE RESTRICTIONS: This is strictly a 16+ event. Due to the event running through the night, anyone under the age of 18 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian [aged 18+] for the full duration of the marathon.

title: The Conversation
description: Coppola’s masterful thriller and Cannes Palme d’Or winner showcases what may be Gene Hackman’s greatest performance. Lonely wiretapping expert and devout Catholic Harry Caul (Hackman) is hired to record a seemingly innocuous conversation between two lovers in San Francisco’s Union Square. Upon re-hearing the tapes, however, Caul believes he may be putting the couple in danger if he turns the material over to his client (Robert Duvall). But what one hears can ultimately turn out to be quite different from what was actually recorded. Restored in 4K in 2024 by American Zoetrope, in collaboration with Studiocanal at Roundabout Entertainment and American Zoetrope laboratories, from the original negative accessed for the first time. An approved 35mm reference print was used for the color grading. 5.1 soundtrack created in 2000 by Walter Murch. Restoration approved by Francis Ford Coppola. Winner: Palme d’Or, Cannes Film Festival 1974

title: Once Upon A Time In… Hollywood
description: Quentin Tarantino’s Once Upon a Time in… Hollywood visits 1969 Los Angeles, where everything is changing, as TV star Rick Dalton (Leonardo DiCaprio) and his longtime stunt double Cliff Booth (Brad Pitt) make their way around an industry they hardly recognize anymore. The ninth film from the writer-director features a large ensemble cast and multiple storylines in a tribute to the final moments of Hollywood’s golden age.

title: Female Trouble
description: “Sex offenses that would shock the Marquis de Sade!” sniffed critic Rex Reed in the Daily News, reviewing John Waters’ follow-up to the notorious Pink Flamingos . The perversities pile up in the tale of high-school delinquent and meatball sandwich-lover Dawn Davenport (played by Waters muse Divine), whose number one Christmas wish is for a pair of cha-cha heels. But her parents fail to heed her request, and her rage leads inexorably to stripping, prostitution, disfigurement, tabloid fame and mass murder.

title: Station West
description: After two U.S. cavalrymen transporting a gold shipment get killed, U.S. Army Intelligence investigator John Haven goes undercover to a mining and logging town to find the killers.

title: EXCALIBUR
description: The legend of King Arthur and the Knights of the Round Table receives its most impressive screen treatment in EXCALIBUR, from visionary director John Boorman (DELIVERANCE, HOPE AND GLORY).

title: Josephine
description: After eight-year-old Josephine witnesses a violent assault in San Francisco’s Golden Gate Park, the trauma begins to reshape her world, and her fear and confusion slowly unravel the household around her. Channing Tatum and Gemma Chan star as her parents in Beth de Araújo’s acclaimed drama, winner of both the Grand Jury Prize and the Audience Award at the 2026 Sundance Film Festival.

title: Naza
description: In secret conversations on the rooftops of Tel Aviv at night, the systems behind Israel’s calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians in Gaza are revealed by the people who designed and operated them. We made this film out of a sense of obligation to use our position as Israeli filmmakers and journalists to examine the systems behind the mass killing of Palestinian civilians for which our country is responsible. While filming members of Israel’s military on rooftops at night in Tel Aviv over the past three years, we found ourselves asking the very questions that were asked by our grandparents’ generation and throughout the 20th century: how does one group of people allow the total dehumanization of another? What do the inner workings of such a system look like? Many of the revelations in the film were published almost immediately as we learned of them, in the months following the October 7th attacks, by The Guardian (one of NAZA ’s producers), in collaboration with reporting partners +972 Magazine and Local Call. The film lets us explore something deeper than we could in our investigative journalism alone: not only the words being said but also those that are not said, the silence. It is up to all of us to break that silence. — Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor

title: Ben'imana
description: In 2012, eighteen years after the genocide against the Tutsi, a Rwandan village is still learning how to live with itself. Vénéranda has spent years helping survivors and the families of those responsible speak the words that were never said between them. However, forgiveness comes easier when it’s someone else’s story. When her own daughter’s future becomes entangled with the past, Vénéranda is forced to find her own words at last. Spanning three generations of women, BEN’IMANA is an intimate portrait of inherited silence — and the fragile question of whether people who have survived the unspeakable together can still build a life side by side.
