title: RITA, SUE AND BOB TOO
description:
Two Bradford school-leavers babysit for a married couple whose comfortable home seems a world away from their own. When the husband begins an affair with both girls, the arrangement becomes the subject of arguments, gossip and increasingly public humiliation. Everyone has an opinion, and almost nobody behaves well.
Andrea Dunbar’s ferocious writing and Alan Clarke’s unsentimental direction turn a suburban scandal into a filthy, painfully funny portrait of class and sexual power. The girls’ wit keeps cutting through the men’s excuses, while the estate around them refuses to become mere background. British comedy with sharp elbows and absolutely no interest in good taste.

title: Stoker
description: Get swept away in Park Chan-Wook’s sensorial and sensual English-language thriller. After her father dies, India Stoker’s mysterious Uncle Charlie, whom she never knew existed, comes to live with her and her unhinged mother. She comes to suspect this handsome and charming man has ulterior motives and becomes increasingly infatuated with him. Visually astounding and viscerally effective, Stoker ‘s quiet elegant subversion will sneak under your skin and chill you down to the bone.

title: The Shining
description: All work and no play makes Jack a dull boy. Stanley Kubrick’s foreboding masterpiece of psychological terror is an icy Stephen King scare-fest best experienced on screen. Determined to make a new start for his family, Jack Torrance accepts a winter job as caretaker at the remote, snowbound Overlook Hotel to make headway with his frustrated writing career. But as isolation grows and his young son’s disturbing visions intensify, sanity will erode, and the gigantic lodge’s sinister secrets will be revealed. Jack Nicholson, Shelley Duvall, and Danny Lloyd are stellar in one of cinema’s all-time great nightmares, with Scatman Crothers, Joe Turkel, and Philip Stone doing superior work in key supporting roles.

description: Buddy (Will Ferrell) was accidentally transported to the North Pole as a toddler and raised to adulthood among Santa's elves. Unable to shake the feeling that he doesn't fit in, the adult Buddy travels to New York, in full elf uniform, in search of his real father. As it happens, this is Walter Hobbs (James Caan), a cynical businessman. After a DNA test proves this, Walter reluctantly attempts to start a relationship with the childlike Buddy with increasingly chaotic results.

description: An evergreen classic of the holidays! Kris Kringle, seemingly the embodiment of Santa Claus, is asked to portray the jolly old fellow at Macy’s following his performance in the Thanksgiving Day parade. His portrayal is so complete that many begin to question if he truly is Santa Claus, while others question his sanity.

George Bailey, a popular member of the community, is pushed to the edge before the arrival of angel Clarence shows him just what he’ll be missing in life.

title: Grave of the Fireflies
description: Gaze upon any list of the “Top 50 Saddest Movies Ever Made” variety, and you are bound to find 1988’s Grave Of The Fireflies . One of the earliest features produced by Japan’s legendary Studio Ghibli, the film follows orphaned 14-year-old Seita and his little sister Setsuko, in their journey to survive through the bombed-out remnants of their community during the final months of the Pacific War.

title: Hook
description: The boy who was never supposed to grow up has done just that at the beginning of this high-flying adventure from Steven Spielberg. Robin Williams stars as Peter, alongside Dustin Hoffman as the infamous Captain Hook, Julia Roberts as Tinkerbell, Bob Hoskins as the pirate Smee, and Maggie Smith as Granny Wendy Darling, who must convince middle-aged lawyer Peter Banning that he was once the legendary Peter Pan. And so the adventure begins anew, with Peter off to Neverland to save his two children from Captain Hook. Along the way, he rediscovers the power of imagination, friendship, and, of course, pixie dust.

title: SUNDAY SABBATH - MYSTERY HORROR MATINEE
description:
Give your Sunday afternoon to something unsettling. Sunday Sabbath uncovers secret selections from horror’s less-travelled roads: neglected masterpieces, regional nightmares and strange little films that found their own way to get under the skin.
The title remains undisclosed until showtime. It might be a Gothic chill, a creature feature, a psychological trap or something that refuses the usual categories. Come for the surprise; stay for the discovery you could not have chosen from a familiar poster.
Adults only.

title: EC: CHRISTOPHER MACLAINE
description: “The few facts that are known about Maclaine are, at best, sketchy. He was a published poet, a sort of down and out San Francisco bohemian who later became one of the psychic casualties of that scene. His last years were spent at Sunnyacres, a state mental hospital in Fairfield, California. These films, along with Ron Rice’s, are clearly the most significant work to come out of the beat period.” –J.J. Murphy All films preserved by Anthology Film Archives. title: BLAST OF SILENCE
description:
A hired killer comes to New York at Christmas to carry out a routine assignment. Buying a gun and watching his target should be simple enough, but an encounter with an old acquaintance begins to disturb his carefully maintained isolation. The city carries on celebrating around him.
Allen Baron’s lean independent noir turns real Manhattan streets into a landscape of loneliness and approaching violence. Lionel Stander’s gravelly narration needles the killer from inside his own head, while the rough location photography catches a city no studio could reproduce. A bitter Christmas postcard from the gutter, with every ounce of sentiment squeezed out.

title: MONO NO AWARE XX: REDUX PROGRAM
description: Non-profit organization MONO NO AWARE presents eight commissioned works on film from 2026. These films had their premiere at the MONO bi-annual festival of expanded cinema, which took place from Dec 2-13 to sold out audiences. The redux program will present the films for anyone who was unable to attend the larger festival program. For a full list of the works in the program, along with descriptions, please visit: https://mononoawarefilm.com/mono-no-aware-xx

title: The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth
description: Brad Pitt returns to his Academy Award-winning role as Cliff Booth, only this time it’s 1977 and it’s a very different Hollywood. Directed by David Fincher from a screenplay by Quentin Tarantino, the film also stars Elizabeth Debicki, Scott Caan, Carla Gugino, Yahya Abdul-Mateen II and Peter Weller. (Netflix)

title: CIPRÌ & MARESCO PGM 2: (IN)HUMAN URGES
description: The body, in all its abominable candor, is one of the poetic pillars of Ciprì & Maresco’s cinema. Tragically devoid of any female presence, their films frame with sardonic ridicule the violent loneliness of men. Undressed, both literally and metaphorically, the male body is the lone signifier of (in)human urges that are always frustrated, crudely demanded but never fulfilled. The appalling body and its unspeakable impulses are not so much filmed, but structure the vision and cinema of Ciprì & Maresco. The rubble they’re filmed in is not mere background but an unflattering reflection of the human ruins they incarnate. In the cosmically pessimistic universe of Ciprì & Maresco, humanity is doomed, for even life already resembles death. A bitter laughter is the lapidary seal on this dejected, (post-)human landscape. title: Yentl
description: Get ready for an emotional powerhouse when iconic diva Barbra Streisand stands behind the camera for the first time as director and in front of it for the first time in drag in this moving story of gender, tradition, and forbidden romance. Born into a Jewish shtetl in Poland, at a time when girls were forbidden to study religious scriptures, young Yentl masquerades as a boy to enter religious training and unexpectedly finds love along the way. With a powerful and Oscar-winning score from Michel Legrand that includes the classic “Papa, Can You Hear Me?” and Barbra shining in dual roles as first-time director (and the first woman to win the Golden Globe for Best Director) and gender-bending actor, and a story that will move even the staunchest of stone hearts, share this cinematic treasure with those you love and a theater full of weeping Vidiots!

description:
A few days before Christmas, Miles Cullen, a bored teller working at a bank branch located in a shopping mall, accidentally learns that the place is about to be robbed when he finds a disconcerting note on one of the counters.
A chilly, precision-tooled thriller that turns a shopping-mall bank counter into the site of a psychological duel. Duke transforms a simple robbery setup into a battle of wills, where a mild-mannered teller’s quiet cunning clashes with a robber whose calm hides a streak of genuine menace.

title: CIPRÌ & MARESCO PGM 3: CRIMINAL (DIS)ORGANIZATION
description: In the “Cinico TV” sketches and short films devoted to the Mafia and crime more generally, Ciprì & Maresco radically overturn the conventions of political and anti-Mafia cinema. Cosa Nostra does not appear as a mythical, mysterious, or invincible power, but as an ordinary and grotesque presence, immersed in the marginality of the bodies, landscapes, and characters that inhabit their Palermo. Mafia bosses, affiliates, and rituals are stripped of any aura of (anti-)heroism and returned to a dimension that is at once miserable and surreal, where violence coexists with emptiness, absurdity, and everyday degradation. Through silences, distorted dialogue, and pitch-black humor, Ciprì & Maresco dismantle the mythology surrounding the Mafia and reveal its banality as a form of power and oppression. Worst of all, everyone seems to have forgotten the true meaning of Christmas. But using his simple elf ways, Buddy sets out to single-handedly win over his family and save Christmas in New York, hoping to at last find his true place in the world.

So break out of Arkham Asylum and head down to Vidiots for some epic fun!

title: WAKE IN FRIGHT
description:
One night in the Yabba should be enough. But a lost bet strands a schoolteacher in an outback town where hospitality means another drink, another dare and another reason he cannot leave.
Ted Kotcheff turns sunshine and friendliness into instruments of terror. Gary Bond’s careful composure is stripped away by a community whose rituals of masculinity are both welcoming and merciless, with Donald Pleasence an unforgettable guide into the abyss. A sun-blasted nightmare of drinking, belonging and the violence that can hide inside the invitation to be one of the boys.

title: CIPRÌ & MARESCO PGM 4: WITH(OUT) FREEDOM
description: For all the pessimism and cynicism that animates the cinema of Ciprì & Maresco, there is a visionary tension that prevents the lights from going off completely: a glimmer of hopeless and resplendent defiance (Carmelo Bene saw in their films “the grandiosity of the sacred”). Their very art and sarcastic genius are an implicit counterpoint to the existential despair that haunts their films. Informed by an eclectic array of cultural influences, there is a vital force that invigorates every frame, a ludic folly that catches the spectators off guard and floods them with amazement. description: A mad scientist needs Santo’s blood for a youthful serum, and she has Frankenstein’s trusty old monster to help her get it.

title: EC: WALDEN (DIARIES, NOTES, AND SKETCHES)
description: “Since 1950 I have been keeping a film diary. I have been walking around with my Bolex and reacting to the immediate reality: situations, friends, New York, seasons of the year. On some days I shot ten frames, on others ten seconds, still on others ten minutes. Or I shot nothing. When one writes diaries, it’s a retrospective process: you sit down, you look back at your day, and you write it all down. To keep a film (camera) diary, is to react (with your camera) immediately, now, this instant: either you get it now, or you don’t get it at all.” –Jonas Mekas CLICK HERE TO BOOK TICKETS NOW!

title: Moonstruck
description: Get ready to Cher the love! The incomparable Goddess Cher and the one-and-only Nicolas Cage star in this uproarious romantic comedy. No sooner does Italian-American widow Loretta accept a marriage proposal from her doltish boyfriend, Johnny, than she finds herself falling for his younger brother, Ronny. She tries to resist, but Ronny lost his hand in an accident he blames on his brother, and has no scruples about aggressively pursuing her while Johnny is out of the country. As Loretta falls deeper in love, she comes to learn that she’s not the only one in her family with a secret romance. Make sure you Snap Out of It and don’t miss this iconic romance!

title: My Neighbor Totoro
description: All aboard the Cat Bus on which Miyazaki and Studio Ghibli’s reputation rides. From the legendary animation studio behind classics SPIRITED AWAY and PRINCESS MONONOKE comes the tale of two sisters who go on magical adventures with their friendly neighbor — a corpulent forest spirit with a heart of gold. One of the most beloved anime of all time, favored by film lovers of all ages.

title: CIPRÌ & MARESCO PGM 1: CINEMA
description: Erudite and always irreverent cinephiles, Ciprì & Maresco have infused their work with their love for cinema, whether through homages, citations or profanations. Though hyperlocal (their filmmaking never ventured outside their native Palermo), their films have genealogically followed the human and cinematographic trajectories that lead from Sicily to America, and vice versa. They filmed Martin Scorsese recounting the urban articulation of Sicilian villages transplanted to Lower Manhattan and listened to Samuel Fuller chronicling the Allied invasion of Sicily in WWII. (American) Cinema is at the aesthetic center of their work. Their love for John Ford is plastically illustrated in their predilection for long shots, a recurring feature in the films of Ciprì & Maresco. This program gathers sketches from Cinico TV and short films that pay sacrilegious homage to the 7th Art. Fragmented phone calls and unseen movements in the attic create an atmosphere where the familiar is forever on the verge of becoming grotesque.

title: Moonrise Kingdom
description: Put on your coonskin cap, grab your portable record player, and get ready to run away with Wes Anderson’s delightfully designed darling Moonrise Kingdom . Set on an island off the coast of New England in the summer of 1965, Moonrise Kingdom tells the story of two twelve-year-olds who fall in love, make a secret pact, and run away together into the wilderness. As various authorities try to hunt them down, a violent storm is brewing off-shore – and the peaceful island community is turned upside down in more ways than anyone can handle. A hyper-stylized and wonderfully whimsical and offbeat treasure from America’s most brilliantly bespoke director, Moonrise Kingdom is a gorgeous charmer best enjoyed on a big screen!

title: THE UMBRELLAS OF CHERBOURG
description:
They are young, in love and certain they will wait for each other. Then Guy is sent to Algeria, Geneviève discovers she is pregnant, and the future begins asking questions their romance cannot answer.
Every line is sung, every colour seems to carry a feeling, and Michel Legrand’s music makes ordinary heartbreak soar. Jacques Demy and Catherine Deneuve create a world of ravishing surfaces without protecting their characters from money, time or compromise. A musical of overwhelming beauty whose greatest surprise is how clear-eyed it is about love.

title: EC: REMINISCENCES OF A JOURNEY TO LITHUANIA
description: Preserved by Anthology Film Archives with support from The Film Foundation. Special thanks to Cineric, Inc., and Trackwise. “The film consists of four parts. The first part contains some footage from my first years in America, 1949-52. The second part was shot in August 1971 in Lithuania. The third part is in Elmshorn, near Hamburg, where I spent eight months in a forced labor camp. The fourth part is in Vienna (1971) with Peter Kubelka, [Hermann] Nitsch, Annette Michelson, Ken Jacobs, etc. The film deals with home, memory, and culture.” –Jonas Mekas CLICK HERE TO BOOK TICKETS NOW!

title: Dreamgirls
description: Deena (Beyoncé Knowles), Effie (Jennifer Hudson) and Lorrell (Anika Noni Rose) form a music trio called the Dreamettes. When ambitious manager Curtis Taylor Jr. (Jamie Foxx) spots the act at a talent show, he offers the chance of a lifetime, to be backup singers for a national star (Eddie Murphy). Taylor takes creative control of the group and eventually pushes the singers into the spotlight. However, one becomes the star, forcing another out, which teaches them about the high cost of fame.

title: Tangerine
description: Nearly a decade before winning 4 Academy Awards for “Anora”, Sean Baker was lighting the Sundance film festival on fire with Tangerine, a true micro-budget “indie” famously filmed on an Iphone 5S. It’s Christmas Eve at a Donut Shop in Hollywood, and fresh-out-of-jail Transgender Sex Worker Sin-Dee is meeting up with best friend Alexandra, a fellow working girl, who proceeds to drop a bomb on her: Sin-Dee’s boyfriend and pimp, Chester, is cheating on her. The two set-off to find him, traversing through an electric landscape of seedy motels and Santa Monica Boulevard street scenes that make this a true Los Angeles movie. A punchy, raucous buddy comedy with a massive heart, with an ending shot that will make you want to call your own best friend.

title: Edward Scissorhands
description: In a castle high on top of a hill lives an inventor's greatest creation - Edward, a near-complete person. The creator died before he could finish Edward's hands; instead, he is left with metal scissors for hands. Since then, he has lived alone, until a kind lady called Peg discovers him and welcomes him into her home. At first, everyone welcomes him into the community, but soon things begin to take a change for the worse.

title: Love Actually
description: Nine intertwined stories examine the complexities of the one emotion that connects us all: love. Among the characters explored are David (Hugh Grant), the handsome newly elected British prime minister who falls for a young junior staffer (Martine McCutcheon), Sarah (Laura Linney), a graphic designer whose devotion to her mentally ill brother complicates her love life, and Harry (Alan Rickman), a married man tempted by his attractive new secretary.

title: The Holdovers
description: From acclaimed director Alexander Payne, THE HOLDOVERS follows a curmudgeonly instructor (Paul Giamatti) at a prestigious American school who is forced to remain on campus during Christmas break to babysit the handful of students with nowhere to go. Eventually he forms an unlikely bond with one of them -- a damaged, brainy troublemaker (newcomer Dominic Sessa) -- and with the school’s head cook, who has just lost a son in Vietnam (Da’Vine Joy Randolph).

title: THE GREAT SILENCE
description:
In the snowbound wilderness of Utah, a mute gunslinger known only as Silence drifts into a community terrorised by bounty hunters who exploit harsh winter lawlessness for profit. When a young widow seeks justice for her murdered husband, Silence’s intervention pits him against the glacial brutality of a legendary killer—and the indifferent authority that enables him.
One of the bleakest and most politically charged of all spaghetti westerns, The Great Silence transforms frontier myth into a study of economic predation and moral impotence. Corbucci’s stark compositions and Ennio Morricone’s mournful score frame a landscape where survival favours the ruthless and heroism is swallowed by the snow. The film’s uncompromising conclusion remains a landmark of the genre’s willingness to strip away illusion and confront the cost of violence with unflinching clarity.

title: It's A Wonderful Life
description: Beset with personal and professional problems, George Bailey finds his previously happy life falling apart around him on Christmas Eve. Seeing no way out, George considers suicide from the edge of a bridge ­ but Clarence, his guardian angel, intervenes and shows George what his beloved hometown of Bedford Falls would be like without him.

title: Elf
description: Buddy (Will Ferrell) was accidentally transported to the North Pole as a toddler and raised to adulthood among Santa's elves. Unable to shake the feeling that he doesn't fit in, the adult Buddy travels to New York, in full elf uniform, in search of his real father. As it happens, this is Walter Hobbs (James Caan), a cynical businessman. After a DNA test proves this, Walter reluctantly attempts to start a relationship with the childlike Buddy with increasingly chaotic results.

title: Avengers: Doomsday
description: In “Avengers: Doomsday,” beloved heroes from three distinct universes will be set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they’ve ever encountered.

title: Dune: Part Three
description: Dune: Part Three is set nearly two decades after Paul Atreides seized control of the Imperium. Now a ruthless Emperor, Paul must face the consequences of his reign as old allies return, terrifying new threats emerge, and betrayal lurks in every shadow. Haunted by visions of Imperial collapse and the reappearance of his long-lost love, Paul is drawn into a sweeping conspiracy, with Chani at the heart of its unfolding mystery. As rebellion brews and enemies close in, Paul must confront the true cost of power and the fate of those he loves the most.

title: Home Alone
description: Every parent’s nightmare gets turned into every child’s fantasy in this much-loved 90s classic. Waking to find a deserted home, Kevin McAllister swiftly goes about having the time of his life. Supermarket trips are reinvented as riotous affairs, an empty mansion becomes the ideal playground, and everyday household items turn into the ideal deterrent for a pair of bumbling crooks with their eyes on the abandoned house.

title: The Muppet Christmas Carol
description: 'Tis the season for love, laughter, and one of the most cherished stories of all time! Join Kermit the Frog, Miss Piggy, and all the hilarious Muppets in this merry, magical version of Charles Dickens' classic tale. Academy Award® winner Michael Caine (Best Supporting Actor) gives a performance that's anything but "bah, humbug!" as greedy, penny-pinching Ebenezer Scrooge. One fateful Christmas Eve, Scrooge is visited by the Ghosts of Christmas Past, Present, and Future. Together with kind, humble Bob Cratchit (Kermit the Frog) and his family, the Spirits open Scrooge's eyes -- and his heart -- to the true meaning of Christmas. Filled with original music and dazzling special effects, THE MUPPET CHRISTMAS CAROL will become a holiday tradition your family will treasure all the days of the year. Featuring the film’s famous long-lost song ‘When Love is Gone’! ------ As always you can expect SING ALONG performances of this new version of THE MUPPET CHRISTMAS CAROL this Christmas - and now we don't need to pretend that we weren't going to just play the lost scene regardless! Performances will feature a Hosted Pre-Show with our very own Father Christmas, where you will be prepped on what to do throughout the film. Costumes aren't mandatory, but 'Tis the season, and we love seeing you dressed up in your favourite Christmas Jumpers! All this, and a few more surprises up our sleeves, makes this one of the must-see events this Christmas! If you're wanting to Sing Along with The Muppet Christmas Carol, simply book for the performances marked SING ALONG [it's next to the start time]. All other screenings will be regular performances, and nothing will be written next to the start time.

title: Home Alone
description: When bratty 8-year-old Kevin McCallister (Macaulay Culkin) acts out the night before a family trip to Paris, his mother (Catherine O'Hara) makes him sleep in the attic. After the McCallisters mistakenly leave for the airport without Kevin, he awakens to an empty house and assumes his wish to have no family has come true. But his excitement sours when he realizes that two con men (Joe Pesci, Daniel Stern) plan to rob the McCallister residence, and that he alone must protect the family home.

title: Avengers: Doomsday

title: Elf
description: Everybody’s favorite giant elf is back and bringing joy and laughter to Vidiots’ big screen! Will Ferrell is Buddy – Santa’s most enthusiastic little helper in this delightful and beloved Christmas comedy. When young Buddy falls into Santa’s gift sack on Christmas Eve, he’s transported back to the North Pole and raised as a toy-making elf by Santa’s helpers. But as he grows into adulthood, he can’t shake the nagging feeling that he doesn’t belong. Buddy vows to visit Manhattan and find his real dad, a workaholic. Bring the whole family (or your fellow elves) to Vidiots to revel in the magic of this classic with a crowd!

title: DIAL CODE: SANTA CLAUSE
description:
Thomas de Frémont, a precocious child obsessed with action films, sets himself up for a terrifying Christmas Eve after he unwittingly makes contact with a deranged psychopath who claims he’s Santa Claus.
Inventive, visually exuberant, and threaded with a dark fairy-tale logic, Dial Code: Santa Claus stands as one of the most striking European holiday thrillers of its era—a precursor to Home Alone with sharper teeth.

title: The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth
description: Brad Pitt returns to his Academy Award-winning role as Cliff Booth, only this time it’s 1977 and it’s a very different Hollywood. Directed by David Fincher from a screenplay by Quentin Tarantino, the film also stars Elizabeth Debicki, Scott Caan, Carla Gugino, Yahya Abdul-Mateen II and Peter Weller. (Netflix)

title: Female Trouble on 35mm
description: Feeling down about the possibility that Santa won’t bring you Cha-Cha heels for Christmas this year? Never fear, delinquent Dawn Davenport (Divine) is here to live out the bizarre and beautiful life of crime you can only fantasize about. Female Trouble is yet another John Waters classic, a grotesque examination of the female condition and cycles of violence presented through the flashy and trashy lens of the Pope of Filth. There’s a reason Waters himself considers this his favorite of his early work, and why Mink Stole has named Taffy Davenport as her favorite role in Dreamland. “Hey, spare me your morals!” and give yourself over to violence and perversion.

But the festivities are interrupted by a group of terrorists who take over the exclusive high-rise, and everyone in it. Very soon McClane realizes that there's no one to save the hostages -- but him.

title: Die Hard
description: One man, one vest, one alternative Christmas classic. NYDP officer John McClane’s return to LA coincides with an organisation’s attack on his wife’s towering workplace, right in the middle of their office party. Bruce Willis single-handedly takes on a fleet of German terrorists – led by Alan Rickman’s imperious Hans Gruber – in a seasonally tinged action movie. Yippee ki-yay indeed!

title: SILENT NIGHT, DEADLY NIGHT
description:
After witnessing his parents’ murder on Christmas Eve, a young boy is raised in a stern Catholic orphanage where punishment is confused with morality and fear becomes ritual. Years later, working in a small-town toy store during the holidays, his unresolved trauma resurfaces—triggering a violent descent that turns Santa’s red suit into an emblem of terror.
A flashpoint in 1980s moral-panic culture, Silent Night, Deadly Night filters slasher conventions through the anxieties of Reagan-era Americana: the collision of family values, religious discipline, and the commodified cheer of the holiday season. Lean, grubby, and unexpectedly sad beneath its notoriety, the film stands as a snapshot of an era when horror’s transgressions clashed loudly with its audience’s ideals.

description: There’s no better way to learn special holiday lessons of kindness and generosity than with Jim Henson’s beloved puppets! The Muppets team up with esteemed actor Michael Caine for a retelling of the classic Dickens tale of Ebenezer Scrooge, miser extraordinaire. He is held accountable for his dastardly ways during night-time visitations by the puppet Ghosts of Christmas Past, Present, and Future. Bless us one and all – humans and Muppets alike!

title: The Muppet Christmas Carol
description: Kermit, Oscar the Grouch, Miss Piggy and the gang get to grips with Charles Dickens’ Christmas favourite in this beloved take on the classic tale. In amongst the Muppet family, Michael Caine steps into the slippers of the miserly Ebenezer Scrooge with great grumpy relish as a trio of ghostly visitations attempt to banish his bah-humbug spirit.

title: Die Hard
description: 40 stories of sheer adventure best experienced projected in 35mm! John McTiernan’s Die Hard is a stone cold action classic, igniting a blockbuster film franchise and decades of imitators. Bruce Willis is New York City detective John McLane, the lone hope for a Los Angeles high-rise of hostages seized by terrorists on Christmas Eve. The odds are against him and that’s just the way he likes it.

title: It’s a Wonderful Life
description:
The ultimate Christmas comforter is welcomed back to the Electric for our seasonal trip to the town of Bedford Falls. This year, celebrating it's 80th anniversary.

George Bailey, a popular member of the community, is pushed to the edge before the arrival of angel Clarence shows him just what he’ll be missing in life.

title: Die Hard
description: You know we couldn’t bring you a holiday season without this action-packed Christmas Banger! NYPD cop John McClane’s plan to reconcile with his estranged wife is thrown for a serious loop when, minutes after he arrives at her office, the entire building is overtaken by a group of terrorists. With little help from the LAPD, wisecracking McClane sets out to single-handedly rescue the hostages and bring the bad guys down. Bring the whole office down to Nakatomi Plaza for one hell of a holiday party!

title: The Wizard of Oz
description: We’re off to see the Wizard! Take a fantastic trip down the yellow brick road with this dazzling and entertaining musical fantasy that will delight the whole family! Based on the book series from Frank L. Baum, let this cinematic marvel pull you back into its tornado of magic all over again. Young Dorothy finds herself in a magical world where she makes friends with a lion, a scarecrow and a tin man as they make their way along the yellow brick road to talk with the Wizard and ask for the things they miss most in their lives. The Wicked Witch of the West is the only thing that could stop them. Grab your best anthropomorphic friends and take a broom ride to the magical world of Oz.

title: Duck Soup             / The Cocoanuts
description: Enjoy a bowl of Duck Soup , hilariously served by the genius of The Marx Brothers – Groucho, Harpo, Chico, and Zeppo. Grouch plays Rufus T. Firefly, who at the behest of the wealthy widow Mrs. Gloria Tisdale (Margaret Dumont), becomes the leader of Freedonia, a country that is about to be taken over by neighboring Sylvania and its scheming Ambassador. There are plenty of quotable one liners and delightfully choreographed physical gags when spies Chicolini (Chico) and Pinky (Harpo) are sent over to spy on Firefly – “You know this means war!” Groucho relishes in the absurdity of it all, and you’ll recognize The Marx Brothers’ vaudevillian influences in countless comedies such as Bananas , Blazing Saddles , Airplane! and Monty Python’s Flying Circus, to name a few. Duck Soup features the famous “mirrorscene” and the dizzying exchange of hats between Chico and Harpo with Edgar Kennedy victimized as a Lemonade Stand vendor, but the key ingredient in Soup , is its political satire, putting it in the rarefied air of The Great Dictator and Dr. Strangelove .

title: Alice in Wonderland
description: We’ve saved you a place at our Mad Tea Party! Fall down the original rabbit hole with this beloved and imaginative animated classic from the surreal novel by Lewis Carroll. On a golden afternoon, young Alice follows a White Rabbit, who disappears down a nearby rabbit hole. Quickly following him, she tumbles into the burrow – and enters the merry, topsy-turvy world of Wonderland with Mad Hatters, smoking caterpillars, anthropomorphic flowers and binocular birds, and even a cryptic disappearing cat all culminating in an encounter with the terrifying Queen of Hearts and her army of playing cards. A remarkable surreal fantasy, this all-time classic never loses its whimsy and fantasy!
director: Clyde Geronimi, Hamilton Luske, Wilfred Jackson

title: BREWSTER MCCLOUD
description: Brewster McCloud lives deep within the cavernous underground of the Houston Astrodome, but his dreams rise much higher. He aims to fly. Not in a plane. But with strapped-on wings he’s designing—encouraged by a mysterious woman who may be his guardian angel.

title: Gremlins 2: The New Batch
description: The most hellzapoppin’, gonzorific, take-no-prisoners gizmopalooza ever unleashed! Joe Dante’s little monster masterpiece multiplies the madness, moving the mayhem to the big city as the mischievous munchies overrun a state-of-the-art new building. Featuring great cameos and gags galore, plus gloriously outlandish practical effects designed by the great Rick Baker, Gremlins 2: The New Batch is pure anarchic energy exploding on screen and one of the most unconventional studio pictures ever.

title: On Her Majesty's Secret Service
description: Agent 007 (George Lazenby) and the adventurous Tracy Di Vicenzo (Diana Rigg) join forces to battle the evil SPECTRE organization in the treacherous Swiss Alps. But the group's powerful leader, Ernst Stavro Blofeld (Telly Savalas), is launching his most calamitous scheme yet: a germ warfare plot that could kill millions!

title: The Holdovers
description: From acclaimed director Alexander Payne, THE HOLDOVERS follows a curmudgeonly instructor (Paul Giamatti) at a prestigious American school who is forced to remain on campus during Christmas break to babysit the handful of students with nowhere to go. Eventually he forms an unlikely bond with one of them -- a damaged, brainy troublemaker (newcomer Dominic Sessa) -- and with the school’s head cook, who has just lost a son in Vietnam (Da’Vine Joy Randolph).

title: The Apartment
description: Join us for this adorably romantic classic from Billy Wilder. Jack Lemmon plays Bud Baxter – an insignificant clerk in a major insurance conglomerate. Aching to climb the corporate ladder, he devises a scheme to loan out his apartment to the company’s big wigs as a place to bring their side dishes in private. His brilliant plan goes awry when he discovers the adorable girl from the elevator he’s been flirting with (Shirley MacLaine at her peak cuteness) is also his boss’ mistress. Winner of 5 Academy Awards and generally regarded as one of the best films ever made, The Apartment is a poignant romantic comedy that never gets old.

title: The History of Concrete
description: Following the finale of his TV series, filmmaker John Wilson looks to the bedrock of his beloved New York City for inspiration and structure. Concrete, the world's most widely used building material, appears as an ever-present life force, and John sets out to make the definitive documentary on the matter. To tell this seemingly drab story, he decides to use the industry-approved Hallmark formula to increase his movie's appeal. But his foundation soon begins to crumble – literally and figuratively – as he struggles to balance artistic freedom with the realities of the modern film industry.

title: Amelie - 25th Anniversary
description: 23-year-old Amélie is lonely. After an isolating childhood, she moves to Paris and becomes a waitress at the Café des Deux Moulins, a bar restaurant filled with a colourful cast of diners and employees. One night, Amélie happens across a box of treasures hidden in her apartment, left by a little boy in the Fifties, that changes the course of her life. Henceforth, she dedicates herself to giving back to her community, tracking down the owner of these keepsakes, consoling a widowed neighbour and befriending a reclusive artist. When completing these good deeds, she crosses paths with Nino, a photobooth collagist who shares her oddball sensibilities. She quickly falls in love with him.

title: New York, New York
description: Get ready for Martin Scorsese to bring you a little razzle dazzle over the holidays with this dazzling musical extravaganza starring a magnetic Liza Minnelli and Robert De Niro. Jimmy Doyle (Robert De Niro), an aspiring saxophone player, meets established USO band singer Francine Evans (Liza Minnelli) during V-J Day celebrations at the end of World War II. The two become a musical double act and, more importantly, fall in love. They quickly get married and start a family; however, their volatile relationship disintegrates over time. Years later, when both of them have successful careers, Jimmy and Francine find their paths crossing once again. With Scorsese’s mastery and reverence for the classic Hollywood musical while adding his signature gritty realism, Liza Minnelli’s undeniable explosiveness, and dazzling imagery and music to make you swoon, you’ve never seen a musical like New York, New York , and there’s no better way to see and hear it than on our big screen!

title: The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth
description: Brad Pitt returns to his Academy Award-winning role as Cliff Booth, only this time it’s 1977 and it’s a very different Hollywood. Directed by David Fincher from a screenplay by Quentin Tarantino, the film also stars Elizabeth Debicki, Scott Caan, Carla Gugino, Yahya Abdul-Mateen II and Peter Weller. (Netflix)

title: BATMAN: MASK OF THE PHANTASM
description: In this stylish animated film, Batman battles a dangerous new foe who is trying to frame the Dark Knight for the murder of a crime lord–and who is mysteriously linked to Bruce Wayne’s former girlfriend.
director: Boyd Kirkland, Frank Paur, Kevin Altieri

title: Heat
description: A group of high-end professional thieves start to feel the heat from the LAPD when they unknowingly leave a verbal clue at their latest heist. Original Cut from a 35mm print.

title: Wings of Desire [Der Himmel über Berlin]
description: Two angels, Damiel (Bruno Ganz) and Cassiel (Otto Sander), glide through the streets of Berlin, observing the bustling population, providing invisible rays of hope to the distressed but never interacting with them. When Damiel falls in love with lonely trapeze artist Marion (Solveig Dommartin), the angel longs to experience life in the physical world, and finds--with some words of wisdom from actor Peter Falk (playing himself) -- that it might be possible for him to take human form.

title: Vidiots Hornyfest – Lust, Caution
description: The temperature may be dropping outside, but it’s heating up here at Vidiots because our annual Hornyfest is back and thirstier than ever!

title: The Thing
description: In John Carpenter’s claustrophobic horror whodunit, the crew of a remote Antarctic research center must fight for survival against an alien life form that can assimilate, then imitate, its host. And man is the warmest place to hide. Kurt Russell leads a stellar ensemble cast, while Rob Bottin’s jaw-dropping practical effects continue to shock and amaze.

title: Angel's Egg
description: In an underwater city, a young girl takes care of a large egg she holds carefully in her arms. A boy with a gun arrives in search of a bird he saw in his dream. At first, it seems as if feelings of sympathy are developing between the two. Forty years after the film’s original release, Anime Limited is proud to present an all-new 4K restoration of the film, supervised by director Mamoru Oshii, in cinemas nationwide for the very first time. The film is a creative collaboration between acclaimed director Mamoru Oshii (Ghost in the Shell), who wrote and directed the feature, and revered artist Yoshitaka Amano (Final Fantasy, Vampire Hunter D). The film beautifully intertwines Oshii’s thematic reflections on philosophy and theology with Amano’s distinctive ink painting style, culminating in an arrestingly beautiful hand-drawn allegorical fantasy.

title: Willy Wonka and the Chocolate Factory
description: A sweet boy from a poor family dreams of finding one of five golden tickets hidden inside chocolate bar wrappers which will admit him to the eccentric and reclusive Willy Wonka's magical factory. One after another, tickets are discovered by ghastly children - but will the lad find the last remaining one and have all his dreams come true?

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
description: Vidiots is finally bringing you the full day of hobbits, wizards, elves and masterful fantasy you’ve been asking for with an entire day of Peter Jackson’s original epic Lord of the Rings trilogy! Start off this magical day with the enchanting first installment – The Fellowship of the Ring !

title: Relaxed Screening: Arco (PG)
description: This animated, time-travelling odyssey is an optimistic look into our future.

title: La Haine
description: Hatred breeds hatred... 24 hours in the lives of three young men in the French suburbs the day after a violent riot.

title: Dune: Part Three (cert TBC)
description: The epic conclusion to Denis Villeneuve's adaptation of the beloved sci-fi novels, where an all-powerful Timothée Chalamet faces up against the universe.

title: The Odyssey
description: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.

title: Gremlins 2: The New Batch
description: The most hellzapoppin’, gonzorific, take-no-prisoners gizmopalooza ever unleashed! Joe Dante’s little monster masterpiece multiplies the madness, moving the mayhem to the big city as the mischievous munchies overrun a state-of-the-art new building. Featuring great cameos and gags galore, plus gloriously outlandish practical effects designed by the great Rick Baker, Gremlins 2: The New Batch is pure anarchic energy exploding on screen and one of the most unconventional studio pictures ever.

title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
description: The Grand Budapest Hotel tells of a legendary concierge at a famous European hotel between the wars and his friendship with a young employee who becomes his trusted protégé. The story involves the theft and recovery of a priceless Renaissance painting, the battle for an enormous family fortune and the slow and then sudden upheavals that transformed Europe during the first half of the 20th century.

title: DONT LOOK BACK
description:
Dylan on stage is only half the story. In hotel rooms, backstage corridors and combative interviews during his 1965 British tour, he is inventing—and resisting—the public figure everyone wants him to become.
D. A. Pennebaker’s camera catches the wit, the cruelty, the boredom and the sudden electricity without a narrator telling us what to think. From the cue cards of “Subterranean Homesick Blues” to performances alive with concentration, this landmark music documentary puts you in the room at the moment a musician becomes an enigma.

title: The Godfather
description: Widely regarded as one of the greatest films of all time, this mob drama, based on Mario Puzo's novel of the same name, focuses on the powerful Italian-American crime family of Don Vito Corleone (Marlon Brando). When the don's youngest son, Michael (Al Pacino), reluctantly joins the Mafia, he becomes involved in the inevitable cycle of violence and betrayal. Although Michael tries to maintain a normal relationship with his wife, Kay (Diane Keaton), he is drawn deeper into the family business.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
description: Vidiots is finally bringing you the full day of hobbits, wizards, elves and masterful fantasy you’ve been asking for with an entire day of Peter Jackson’s original epic Lord of the Rings trilogy! Continue on the magical journey with The Two Towers!

title: Dune: Part Three (cert TBC)
description: The epic conclusion to Denis Villeneuve's adaptation of the beloved sci-fi novels, where an all-powerful Timothée Chalamet faces up against the universe.

title: The Social Network
description: In 2003, Harvard undergrad and computer programmer Mark Zuckerberg begins work on a new concept that eventually turns into the global social network known as Facebook. Six years later, Mark is one of the youngest billionaires ever, but his unprecedented success leads to both personal and legal complications when he ends up on the receiving end of two lawsuits, one involving his former friend.

title: When Harry Met Sally
description: In 1977, college graduates Harry Burns (Billy Crystal) and Sally Albright (Meg Ryan) share a contentious car ride from Chicago to New York, during which they argue about whether men and women can ever truly be strictly platonic friends. Ten years later, Harry and Sally meet again at a bookstore, and in the company of their respective best friends, Jess (Bruno Kirby) and Marie (Carrie Fisher), attempt to stay friends without sex becoming an issue between them.

title: DOWN BY LAW
description:
A disc jockey, a small-time pimp and an Italian tourist find themselves sharing a Louisiana prison cell. Two are determined to remain miserable; the third has enough enthusiasm to irritate them both. An escape offers the prospect of freedom and a whole new set of problems.
Tom Waits, John Lurie and Roberto Benigni make an extraordinary comic trio in Jim Jarmusch’s deadpan fugitive tale. Robby Müller’s luminous monochrome photography turns cheap rooms and swamp water into a world suspended somewhere between noir and a ramshackle fairy tale. Losers, awkward silences and immaculate cool, with an unexpected warmth beneath the grime.

title: The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth
description: Brad Pitt returns to his Academy Award-winning role as Cliff Booth, only this time it’s 1977 and it’s a very different Hollywood. Directed by David Fincher from a screenplay by Quentin Tarantino, the film also stars Elizabeth Debicki, Scott Caan, Carla Gugino, Yahya Abdul-Mateen II and Peter Weller. (Netflix)

title: The Godfather : Part II
description: The compelling sequel to "The Godfather," contrasting the life of Corleone father and son. Traces the problems of Michael Corleone (Al Pacino) in 1958 and that of a young immigrant Vito Corleone (Robert De Niro) in 1917's Hell's Kitchen. Michael survives many misfortunes and Vito is introduced to a life of crime.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
description: Vidiots is finally bringing you the full day of hobbits, wizards, elves and masterful fantasy you’ve been asking for with an entire day of Peter Jackson’s original epic Lord of the Rings trilogy!

title: Dune: Part Three (cert TBC)
description: The epic conclusion to Denis Villeneuve's adaptation of the beloved sci-fi novels, where an all-powerful Timothée Chalamet faces up against the universe.

title: Project Hail Mary
description: Science teacher Ryland Grace wakes up on a spaceship light years from home with no recollection of who he is or how he got there. As his memory returns, he begins to uncover his mission: solve the riddle of the mysterious substance causing the sun to die out. He must call on his scientific knowledge and unorthodox ideas to save everything on Earth from extinction.

title: THE CREMATOR
description:
Karel, a mild-mannered crematorium worker, becomes increasingly obsessed with the idea of “cleansing” humanity through death, aligning his private rituals with the rise of Nazi ideology. As his moral compass erodes, he descends into madness, turning the people around him into victims of his delusional sense of duty.
A darkly comic and chilling horror, The Cremator blends psychological terror with surreal satire, offering a haunting meditation on complicity, obsession, and the banality of evil.

title: Chungking Express
description: Love is sweet, but for one pineapple-loving officer, it’s turned as sour as the expired fruit he’s vowed to eat for a month or, at least, until his ex-girlfriend returns, whichever comes first. Thus begins the twin-tale of two jilted Hong Kong cops, who cross paths with two very different women. Cop 223 (Takeshi Kaneshiro, star of FALLEN ANGELS) falls for a drug-smuggling femme fatale (Brigitte Lin) in a blonde wig. Meanwhile Cop 663 (Tony Leung Chiu-wai) becomes the object of affection for a Mamas and the Papas-loving pixie (Cantopop superstar Faye Wang in her film debut) when he visits a late-night take-out stand. A charming and thoroughly enjoyable work from the master stylist, this film made an icon out of Wong Kar Wai and his young stars, becoming an instant classic of ‘90s cinema upon its release.

title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes in 3D
Casablanca
description: Rick Blaine (Humphrey Bogart), who owns a nightclub in Casablanca, discovers his old flame Ilsa (Ingrid Bergman) is in town with her husband, Victor Laszlo (Paul Henreid). Laszlo is a famed rebel, and with Germans on his tail, Ilsa knows Rick can help them get out of the country.

title: Labyrinth - 40th Anniversary
description: Step back into the fantastical world of Jim Henson’s Labyrinth as the beloved classic returns to cinemas for a special 40th-anniversary re-release. Starring David Bowie in one of his most entertaining film performances as the enigmatic Goblin King, this 4K re-issue brings Jim Henson’s dazzling puppetry, imaginative landscapes, and iconic musical moments back to the big screen where they belong. Join the adventure as Sarah (Jennifer Connelly) races against time to navigate the mysterious Labyrinth and rescue her baby brother in this spellbinding cult favourite.

title: Blade Runner : The Final Cut
description: Deckard (Harrison Ford) is forced by the police Boss (M. Emmet Walsh) to continue his old job as Replicant Hunter. His assignment: eliminate four escaped Replicants from the colonies who have returned to Earth. Before starting the job, Deckard goes to the Tyrell Corporation and he meets Rachel (Sean Young), a Replicant girl he falls in love with.

title: The Pirates! Band of Misfits in 3D
Backrooms: Everything Must Go Edition With Bonus Footage
description: A strange doorway appears in the basement of a furniture showroom.

title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
description: Follow Vidiots through the wardrobe for this fantastical and lush adaptation of the beloved C.S. Lewis novel!

title: Fallen Angels
description: An assassin goes through obstacles as he attempts to escape his violent lifestyle despite the opposition of his partner, who is secretly attracted to him.

title: Blue Heron
description: Set on Vancouver Island in the late 1990s, Blue Heron follows eight‑year‑old Sasha and her Hungarian immigrant family as they attempt to build a new life, only to be destabilised by the increasingly dangerous behaviour of her older brother, Jeremy. Drawing on her own memories, filmmaker Sophy Romvari shapes a deeply personal portrait of childhood, family fractures, and the fragility of recollection.

title: KAMIKAZE GIRLS
description:
Obsessed with Rococo fashion and the fantasy of an aristocratic eighteenth-century France, solitary Lolita Momoko lives a life of elaborate daydreams in rural Japan. Her carefully constructed world is disrupted when she forms an unlikely friendship with Ichigo, a foul-mouthed member of an all-female biker gang. Despite their opposing personalities, the pair embark on a series of misadventures that gradually reveal an unexpected bond.
Adapted from Novala Takemoto's novel, Kamikaze Girls established Tetsuya Nakashima as one of Japan's most inventive visual stylists. Blending hyperactive editing, pop-art imagery and irreverent comedy with genuine emotional warmth, the film celebrates individuality, female friendship and the liberating power of subculture. Since its release, it has become a modern cult favourite and one of the defining cinematic portraits of Japan's Lolita fashion movement.
Programmed and introduced by Elizabeth Pollitt

title: Cinematic Void Presents SANTO CONTRA HOMBRES INFERNALES
description: Agent Joaquin recalls his latest mission while lying wounded in an ambulance: Joaquin has infiltrated into a band of smugglers. When the villains learn the truth about him, they kidnap Jouqin’s fiancee. Santo comes to her rescue and fights the band.

title: The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth
description: Brad Pitt returns to his Academy Award-winning role as Cliff Booth, only this time it’s 1977 and it’s a very different Hollywood. Directed by David Fincher from a screenplay by Quentin Tarantino, the film also stars Elizabeth Debicki, Scott Caan, Carla Gugino, Yahya Abdul-Mateen II and Peter Weller. (Netflix)

title: Vidiots Hornyfest – Call Me by Your Name
description: The temperature may be dropping outside, but it’s heating up here at Vidiots because our annual Hornyfest is back and thirstier than ever!

title: Zodiac
description: Police conduct a manhunt for the Zodiac Killer, a serial killer who terrorized the San Francisco Bay Area during the late 1960s and early 1970s, taunting police with letters, bloodstained clothing, and ciphers mailed to newspapers.

title: 2001 : A Space Odyssey
description: When a mysterious artifact is uncovered on the Moon, a spacecraft manned by two scientists and one supercomputer is dispatched to Jupiter to find its origins. Please Note: Our 70mm screenings of '2001: A Space Odyssey' follow a partictular presentation procedure; - Overture (3mins / Music) - 1st half of feature (86mins) - * Intermission* (usually 10 for quieter shows, can be 20mins for busier ones) - Entracte (2mins / Music) - 2nd half of feature (54mins) - Exit (5mins / Music) - Total time; approx 170mins (though this is dependent on Intermission length)

title: Phantom of the Rue Morgue in 3D
Dune: Part Three (cert TBC)
description: The epic conclusion to Denis Villeneuve's adaptation of the beloved sci-fi novels, where an all-powerful Timothée Chalamet faces up against the universe.

title: Nirvanna the Band the Show the Movie
description: When their plan to book a show at the Rivoli goes horribly wrong, Matt and Jay accidentally travel back to the year 2008.

title: DIABOLIQUE
description:
A cruel headmaster has made enemies of both his wife and his mistress. Together they devise the perfect murder. Then the body disappears—and the most frightening question becomes whether their victim is really dead.
Henri-Georges Clouzot turns damp corridors, a neglected swimming pool and two extraordinary performances into an almost unbearable machine of suspicion. Simone Signoret’s steel meets Véra Clouzot’s mounting terror in a thriller that understands how guilt makes every ordinary sound threatening. Go in knowing as little as possible; leave the secrets in the cinema.

title: SLAVE OF THE CANNIBAL GOD
description: After creating some of the best gialli of the ‘70s, director Sergio Martino (ALL THE COLORS OF THE DARK) entered the cannibal cycle with this “blood and guts gorefest” (Trailers From Hell) that “still packs a punch” (Rock! Shock! Pop!) and is presented in UHD for the first time ever: When a British scientist disappears in the jungles of New Guinea, his wife (Ursula Andress) hires an American anthropologist (Stacy Keach) to lead her deep into a green inferno of graphic violence, steamy nudity and several of the most notorious scenes in the entire genre. Claudio Cassinelli (THE GREAT ALLIGATOR) co-stars in what Daily Grindhouse hails as “ROMANCING THE STONE for deviants,” now scanned in 4K from the original camera negative.

title: Ghost in the Shell
description: In this Japanese animation, cyborg federal agent Maj. Motoko Kusanagi (Mimi Woods) trails "The Puppet Master" (Abe Lasser), who illegally hacks into the computerized minds of cyborg-human hybrids. Her pursuit of a man who can modify the identity of strangers leaves Motoko pondering her own makeup and what life might be like if she had more human traits. With her partner (Richard George), she corners the hacker, but her curiosity about her identity sends the case in an unforeseen direction.

title: Sunshine
description: * ON SALE 23rd NOV * Fifty years into the future, the sun is dying, and Earth is threatened by arctic temperatures. A team of astronauts is sent to revive the Sun — but the mission fails. Seven years later, a new team is sent to finish the mission as mankind’s last hope.

title: 2001 : A Space Odyssey
description: When a mysterious artifact is uncovered on the Moon, a spacecraft manned by two scientists and one supercomputer is dispatched to Jupiter to find its origins. Please Note: Our 70mm screenings of '2001: A Space Odyssey' follow a partictular presentation procedure; - Overture (3mins / Music) - 1st half of feature (86mins) - * Intermission* (usually 10 for quieter shows, can be 20mins for busier ones) - Entracte (2mins / Music) - 2nd half of feature (54mins) - Exit (5mins / Music) - Total time; approx 170mins (though this is dependent on Intermission length)

title: Project Hail Mary
description: Science teacher Ryland Grace wakes up on a spaceship light years from home with no recollection of who he is or how he got there. As his memory returns, he begins to uncover his mission: solve the riddle of the mysterious substance causing the sun to die out. He must call on his scientific knowledge and unorthodox ideas to save everything on Earth from extinction.

title: Ocean’s Eleven (1960)
description: Get ready to steal all of Las Vegas with the original Rat Pack in this genre-defining hep cat heist movie! Danny Ocean (Frank Sinatra) calls on some of his World War II buddies — including Jimmy Foster (Peter Lawford), Sam Harmon (Dean Martin) and Josh Howard (Sammy Davis Jr.) — to pull off an elaborate New Year’s Eve heist at five casinos in Las Vegas. Eleven members of Danny’s crew come together to pull off a perfect robbery, but they suffer a series of setbacks when Duke Santos (Cesar Romero), a former gangster, tries to thwart Ocean’s plans to disappear with the money.

title: In The Mood For Love
description: In 1962 Hong Kong, neighbors Su Li-zhen (Mrs. Chan) and Chow Mo-wan (Mr. Chow) discover their spouses are having an affair. As they spend time together, they develop feelings for each other, but their relationship remains chaste and unspoken, reflecting societal constraints and their own moral compass.

title: Marie Antoinette
description: An Austrian teenager marries the Dauphin of France and becomes that country's queen following the death of King Louis XV in 1774. Years later, after a life of luxury and privilege, Marie Antoinette loses her head during the French Revolution.

title: LAST NIGHT
description:
The world will end at midnight, and everybody knows it. Across Toronto, people decide how to spend their remaining hours: with family, with strangers, pursuing unfinished business or simply trying to be left alone. Two people who had very different plans find themselves facing the countdown together.
Don McKellar makes the apocalypse intimate, funny and quietly devastating, with Sandra Oh at the heart of a city drifting between panic and ordinary routine. Even David Cronenberg turns up, making customer-service calls as civilisation expires. An end-of-the-world film concerned with the strange, embarrassing business of being human right up to the last second.

title: The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth
description: Brad Pitt returns to his Academy Award-winning role as Cliff Booth, only this time it’s 1977 and it’s a very different Hollywood. Directed by David Fincher from a screenplay by Quentin Tarantino, the film also stars Elizabeth Debicki, Scott Caan, Carla Gugino, Yahya Abdul-Mateen II and Peter Weller. (Netflix)

title: Star Trek: First Contact
description: Vidiots remembers our beloved interstellar captain, Sir Patrick Stewart , with a special screening of Star Trek: First Contact !

title: Phantom Thread
description: In 1950s London, renowned British dressmaker Reynolds Woodcock comes across Alma, a young, strong-willed woman, who soon becomes ever present in his life as his muse and lover.

title: Boogie Nights
description: In the San Fernando Valley in 1977, teenage busboy Eddie Adams (Mark Wahlberg) gets discovered by porn director Jack Horner (Burt Reynolds), who transforms him into adult-film sensation Dirk Diggler. Brought into a supportive circle of friends, including fellow actors Amber Waves (Julianne Moore), Rollergirl (Heather Graham) and Reed Rothchild (John C. Reilly), Dirk fulfills all his ambitions, but a toxic combination of drugs and egotism threatens to take him back down.

title: Dune: Part Three (cert TBC)
description: The epic conclusion to Denis Villeneuve's adaptation of the beloved sci-fi novels, where an all-powerful Timothée Chalamet faces up against the universe.

title: GO
description:
A group of young adults in late-1990s Los Angeles become entangled in a chaotic chain of events involving drugs, stolen goods, and a botched deal that unfolds over the course of a single night. The narrative is split into interlocking segments that replay the same events from different perspectives, gradually revealing how misunderstandings and impulsive decisions escalate the situation.
Go
is a multi-threaded, non-linear crime comedy, using repetition and shifting viewpoint to reframe cause and consequence. Its nightclub and suburban settings are used to track intersecting lives, with pacing that alternates between frantic energy and controlled rewind, highlighting how small choices compound into larger consequences.

title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
description: Hacks breakout star Hannah Einbinder and, in a playful bit of meta-casting, Gillian Anderson (The X Files, Sex Education) headline this heady, gory slasher homage from writer-director Jane Schoenbrun. Like Schoenbrun’s previous films I Saw the TV Glow and We’re All Going to the World’s Fair, it uses a horror genre lens to explore a rich array of themes and ideas – queer identity and sexuality, memory and nostalgia, the nature of female desire, the state of the entertainment industry – with humour, vulnerability and affection. After years of slapdash sequels, the Camp Miasma slasher franchise is handed over to an enthusiastic, cerebral young director (Einbinder) – who credits the first film with her own queer awakening – to resurrect. But fantasy and reality collide when she visits the original film’s star (Anderson), now a mysterious recluse living on its old set, and the two women fall into a blood-soaked world of fear, desire and delirium

title: Rashomon [Rashômon]
description: Set in feudal Japan, this film presents an intriguing tale of violent crime in the woods, told from the perspective of four different characters -- a bandit, a woman, her husband and a woodcutter. Only two things about the incident seem to be clear -- the woman was raped and her husband is now dead. However, the other elements radically differ as the four participants and/or witnesses relate their own stories (with the dead man, eerily enough, speaking through a medium). As each account is revealed, what seemed black-and-white turns to various hues of gray, leading to surprising -- and confounding -- revelations.

title: School of Rock
description: Overly enthusiastic guitarist Dewey Finn (Jack Black) gets thrown out of his bar band and finds himself in desperate need of work. Posing as a substitute music teacher at an elite private elementary school, he exposes his students to the hard rock gods he idolizes and emulates -- much to the consternation of the uptight principal (Joan Cusack). As he gets his privileged and precocious charges in touch with their inner rock 'n' roll animals, he imagines redemption at a local Battle of the Bands.

title: The Odyssey
description: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.

title: The Young and Prodigious T.S. Spivet in 3D
Raise the Red Lantern
description: Celebrating its 35th Anniversary. Raise the Red Lantern is about nineteen-year-old Songlian, a promising student whose family has been destroyed by her father’s death, is forced to abandon her studies and marry into wealth, becoming the fourth and newest concubine of the aging, unseen Master Chen. Inside his walled estate, she discovers a household ruled by a merciless ritual: each night, red lanterns are lit outside the chambers of whichever wife the master chooses to visit, granting her privilege and status while the others are cast into cold irrelevance. Songlian is drawn into the orbit of her rivals, each shaped by years of fighting for the same scraps of attention. Determined at first to rise above the games, Songlian is gradually worn down by isolation and humiliation until she strikes back, trading secrets and favours to secure her place in Master Chen’s hierarchy. As petty cruelty turns even more dire, Songlian is forced to confront what these desperate measures will cost her soul. “As visually striking as it is dramatically effective,” Zhang Yimou’s Academy Award-nominated and BAFTA-winning Raise the Red Lantern sumptuously captures 1920s China while “subtly exploring the politics of power and control” (Janet Maslin, The New York Times). One of international cinema’s greatest stars of the era, Gong Li is “nuanced and understated” (Chicago Reader) as the stifled young woman forced into a repressive world of concubinage. Newly restored, the film stands as one of the defining works of Fifth Generation Chinese cinema and international film of the 1990s. The 4K restoration of Raise the Red Lantern was carried out by the Udine Far East Film Festival on the occasion of its 26th edition. The original image and sound negatives were used under the supervision of Director Zhang Yimou. The vintage positive copy, presented at the 1991 Venice International Film Festival and preserved at the Venice Biennale’s Historical Archive of Contemporary Arts, was used for colour reference. The restoration was made in 2024 at L’Immagine Ritrovata (Hong Kong – Bologna)

title: When Harry Met Sally…
description: Rob Reiner and Nora Ephron team up with a little help from an excellent cast to set the standard for the romantic comedy for decades to come. Quirky, touching, and just a little naughty, come fall in love with this refreshing comedy all over again. During their travel from Chicago to New York, Harry and Sally debate whether or not sex ruins a friendship between a man and a woman. Eleven years later, and they’re still no closer to finding the answer. Come for the ham sandwich orgasm and stay for the New Year’s Eve confession of true love, and all the hilarity, romance, and Carrie Fisher moments in between!

title: Your Name [Kimi no Na wa.]
description: Two teenagers share a profound, magical connection upon discovering they are swapping bodies. Things manage to become even more complicated when the boy and girl decide to meet in person.

title: When Harry Met Sally
description: In 1977, college graduates Harry Burns (Billy Crystal) and Sally Albright (Meg Ryan) share a contentious car ride from Chicago to New York, during which they argue about whether men and women can ever truly be strictly platonic friends. Ten years later, Harry and Sally meet again at a bookstore, and in the company of their respective best friends, Jess (Bruno Kirby) and Marie (Carrie Fisher), attempt to stay friends without sex becoming an issue between them.

title: AT MIDNIGHT I'LL TAKE YOUR SOUL
description:
A defiant undertaker obsessed with the idea of immortality through his bloodline searches for the perfect woman who can bear him a son, a quest that draws him into increasingly brutal crimes in a small Brazilian village. When his own wife is infertile, he kills her and then pursues the fiancée of his friend, dismissing warnings of supernatural retribution even as his violence escalates. After a string of murders and assaults that go unpunished, a local fortune teller foretells that the spirits of his victims will take his soul at midnight. As the cursed night arrives, eerie apparitions and creeping dread force him to confront the consequences of his relentless cruelty.
José Mojica Marins’ At Midnight I’ll Take Your Soul introduced his infamous Coffin Joe character and stands as a foundational work of Brazilian horror cinema, notable for its raw violence, stark moral conflict, and haunting final reel where folklore and vengeance converge.

title: The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth
description: Brad Pitt returns to his Academy Award-winning role as Cliff Booth, only this time it’s 1977 and it’s a very different Hollywood. Directed by David Fincher from a screenplay by Quentin Tarantino, the film also stars Elizabeth Debicki, Scott Caan, Carla Gugino, Yahya Abdul-Mateen II and Peter Weller. (Netflix)

title: Phantom Thread
description: Join us for Paul Thomas Anderson’s fashionable masterpiece Phantom Thread . Renowned dressmaker Reynolds Woodcock and his sister Cyril are at the center of British fashion in 1950s London — dressing royalty, movie stars, heiresses, socialites and debutantes. Women come and go in Woodcock’s life, providing the confirmed bachelor with inspiration and companionship. His carefully tailored existence soon gets disrupted by Alma, a young and strong-willed woman who becomes his muse and lover. An exquisite feast of sumptuous set and (Oscar-winning) costume pieces and astounding performances from Daniel Day-Lewis and Vicky Krieps, this torturous romance is a marvel for the senses.

title: Fight Club
description: Mischief. Mayhem. Soap.

title: 2001 : A Space Odyssey
description: When a mysterious artifact is uncovered on the Moon, a spacecraft manned by two scientists and one supercomputer is dispatched to Jupiter to find its origins.
